s03.vocab.story.02.pages.2.narration: Na basi dogo la kuchezea. Beep beep! Hilo ni gari.
s03.vocab.story.02.pages.3.narration: Chakula, nguo, gari. Makundi matatu kikapu kimoja.

s04.arts.lesson.01.steps.0.narration: Changanya nyekundu na buluu. Gusa kuvimwaga pamoja.
s04.arts.lesson.01.steps.4.feedback: Nyekundu na bluu hutoa zambarau. Umefikiri vizuri!
s04.arts.lesson.01.steps.4.narration: Ungechanganya zipi mbili kupaka rangi ya plamu? Gusa jibu lako.
s04.arts.lesson.01.steps.5.feedback: Rangi mbili, mpya moja. Huo ndio uchanganyaji!
s04.arts.lesson.01.title: Kuchanganya rangi
s04.arts.lesson.02.parentNote: Hakuna jibu sahihi hapa — sherehekea juhudi na rangi.
s04.arts.lesson.02.steps.0.feedback: Mistari ya rangi inafuata kidole chako.
s04.arts.lesson.02.steps.0.narration: Vuta kidole chako kupaka chochote upendacho!
s04.arts.lesson.02.steps.2.feedback: Kubwa na dogo pamoja. Chaguo zuri!
s04.arts.lesson.02.steps.2.narration: Paka umbo kubwa, kisha dogo kando yake.
s04.arts.lesson.02.steps.3.narration: Sasa paka kwa rangi moja tu.
s04.arts.lesson.02.steps.4.feedback: Wewe tu ndiye unajua ni nini. Hiyo ni sanaa!
s04.arts.lesson.02.title: Kupaka rangi kwa vidole
s04.arts.lesson.03.steps.0.narration: Chora macho mawili na pua. Gusa kuviongeza.
s04.arts.lesson.03.steps.2.narration: Ongeza masikio mawili, moja kila upande.
s04.arts.lesson.03.steps.3.feedback: Za mikunjo, zilizonyooka, za mchafuko — zote sahihi!
s04.arts.lesson.03.steps.3.narration: Sasa mpe nywele, kwa namna yoyote unayotaka.
s04.arts.lesson.03.steps.4.feedback: Mstari ule ule, umegeuzwa, unamaanisha kinyume!
s04.arts.lesson.03.steps.4.narration: Chora mdomo wa huzuni badala yake. Ugeuze chini juu.
s04.arts.lesson.03.steps.5.feedback: Miduara na mistari. Sasa waweza kuchora yeyote.
s04.arts.lesson.03.steps.5.narration: Nyuso zimetengenezwa kwa maumbo machache rahisi.
s04.arts.lesson.03.title: Chora uso
s04.arts.lesson.04.parentNote: Tengenezeni bendi kwa vyungu na vijiko nyumbani.
s04.arts.lesson.04.steps.2.narration: Gusa kengele, kisha ngoma, kisha kengele.
s04.arts.lesson.04.steps.4.feedback: Kengele ni laini zaidi. Sikio zuri!
s04.arts.lesson.04.steps.4.narration: Ungetumia kipi kwa wimbo tulivu? Gusa jibu lako.
s04.arts.lesson.04.steps.5.feedback: Hizo ni namna nne za kupiga ngoma moja!
s04.arts.lesson.04.steps.5.narration: Umepiga kwa sauti, laini, haraka na taratibu.
s04.arts.lesson.04.title: Tengeneza muziki
s04.arts.lesson.05.steps.0.narration: Muziki wa haraka. Cheza haraka! Gusa kucheza.
s04.arts.lesson.05.steps.4.narration: Ungechagua muziki upi wa kukusaidia kulala? Gusa jibu lako.
s04.arts.lesson.05.steps.5.feedback: Kusikiliza kwa nafsi nzima. Huko ndiko kucheza.
s04.arts.lesson.05.steps.5.narration: Mwili wako umefuata kila mabadiliko ya muziki.
s04.arts.lesson.05.title: Cheza na kusogea
s04.arts.lesson.06.steps.2.narration: Sasa uwe kitu kidogo. Gusa panya.
s04.arts.lesson.06.steps.3.feedback: Ndege, nyuki, ndege ya anga — wewe chagua!
s04.arts.lesson.06.steps.3.narration: Jifanye kuwa kitu kinachoruka. Gusa jibu lako.
s04.arts.lesson.06.steps.4.narration: Ungekuwa kipi ili ufikie rafu ya juu? Gusa jibu lako.
s04.arts.lesson.06.title: Mchezo wa kuigiza

s04.arts.story.01.pages.0.narration: Leo anapata brashi ya kichawi. Gusa kupaka anga buluu!
s04.arts.story.01.pages.1.narration: Anapaka jua la njano na nyasi za kijani.
s04.arts.story.01.pages.2.narration: Kisha anapata vyungu vingine — nyekundu, zambarau, chungwa.
s04.arts.story.01.pages.3.narration: Anapaka upinde wa mvua, mstari mmoja baada ya mwingine.
s04.arts.story.01.pages.4.narration: Dunia yenye rangi nyingi! Sanaa iko kila mahali.
s04.arts.story.01.parentNote: Uliza mtoto wako angepaka nini kwanza.
s04.arts.story.01.title: Brashi ya kichawi
s04.arts.story.02.pages.0.narration: Ada alipaka jua la njano. Tone la bluu likaanguka juu yake.
s04.arts.story.02.pages.1.narration: Jua likawa la kijani. Ada alisimama, akaangalia.
s04.arts.story.02.pages.2.narration: Karibu ageuke ukurasa safi na kuanza upya.
s04.arts.story.02.pages.3.narration: Badala yake alitazama kijani, akafikiri: nini kingine ni cha kijani?
s04.arts.story.02.pages.4.narration: Kwa hiyo alipaka majani kuizunguka. Sasa ulikuwa mti.

s04.literacy.lesson.03.steps.2.narration: Uimbe tena, taratibu zaidi safari hii.
s04.literacy.lesson.03.steps.4.feedback: Z! Herufi ishirini na sita, na unajua zinapoishia.
s04.literacy.lesson.03.steps.4.narration: Herufi ipi ni ya mwisho kabisa? Gusa jibu lako.

s04.literacy.lesson.04.steps.1.narration: Gusa herufi inayoanza jina lako pamoja na mtu mzima.
s04.literacy.lesson.04.steps.2.narration: Majina ya maeneo huanza na herufi kubwa pia. Gusa K.
s04.literacy.lesson.04.steps.3.feedback: Kila mtu ana herufi maalum ya kwanza!
s04.literacy.lesson.04.steps.3.narration: Gusa herufi ya kwanza ya jina la mtu mzima.
s04.literacy.lesson.04.steps.4.feedback: Majina hupata kubwa. Hiyo ndiyo kanuni!
s04.literacy.lesson.04.steps.4.narration: Herufi zipi ni kubwa, na zipi ni ndogo? Gusa jibu lako.
s04.literacy.lesson.04.steps.5.feedback: Jina lako ndilo neno la kwanza utakaloandika.
s04.literacy.lesson.04.steps.5.narration: Umepata herufi yako na ya mtu mwingine.
s04.literacy.lesson.04.title: Jina langu linaanza na...
s04.literacy.lesson.05.steps.3.feedback: Mwezi na panya. Sauti ya kwanza sawa!
s04.literacy.lesson.05.steps.3.narration: Viwili kati ya hivi vinaanza na /m/. Vigusa vyote.
s04.literacy.lesson.05.steps.4.narration: Jina lako mwenyewe linaanza na sauti gani? Gusa jibu lako.
s04.literacy.lesson.05.steps.5.narration: Umesikia sauti ya kwanza kabisa katika maneno manne.
s04.literacy.lesson.05.title: Sauti za mwanzo
s04.literacy.lesson.06.steps.0.narration: Paka, kaka, baka. Yanasajiana! Gusa kusikia.
s04.literacy.lesson.06.steps.2.narration: Paka, kofia, popo. Gusa uzisikie zikisajili.
s04.literacy.lesson.06.steps.3.narration: Kipi HAKISAJILI na 'man'? Gusa jibu lako.
s04.literacy.lesson.06.steps.4.narration: Tunga wimbo wa kuchekesha kwa jina lako. Gusa jibu lako.
s04.literacy.lesson.06.steps.5.feedback: Umefanya mara nne. Masikio yako yanakuwa makali!
s04.literacy.lesson.06.steps.5.narration: Kusajili ni kusikia mwisho wa neno.

s04.math.lesson.01.steps.3.narration: Puto moja linaruka. Sasa ni mangapi?
s04.math.lesson.01.steps.4.feedback: Tano na tano bado ni kumi. Jumla ile ile!
s04.math.lesson.01.steps.4.narration: Hesabu puto kwa makundi mawili: tano na tano.
s04.math.lesson.01.steps.5.feedback: Kumi ni kumi kwa njia yoyote.
s04.math.lesson.01.steps.5.narration: Umehesabu juu, chini, na kwa makundi.

s04.math.lesson.02.steps.3.narration: Hapa kuna tufaha 4. Gusa namba inayosema idadi.
s04.math.lesson.02.steps.4.feedback: Kila namba ina nafasi yake mstarini.
s04.math.lesson.02.steps.5.feedback: Hilo ndilo wazo linaloshikilia hesabu nyingine zote.
s04.math.lesson.02.steps.5.narration: Kuhesabu na namba sasa vinamaanisha kitu kimoja kwako.

s04.math.lesson.03.steps.2.narration: Nyoosha vidole 2 na 2 zaidi. Ni vingapi?
s04.math.lesson.03.steps.4.feedback: 5 tena! Vidole tofauti, jibu lile lile.
s04.math.lesson.03.steps.5.feedback: Mikono yako ndiyo kikokotoo chako cha kwanza.
s04.math.lesson.03.steps.5.narration: Kujumlisha ni kuweka makundi pamoja tu.
s04.math.lesson.03.title: Jumlisha kwa vidole
s04.math.lesson.04.steps.3.narration: Umbo lipi halina pembe kabisa? Gusa jibu lako.
s04.math.lesson.04.steps.4.narration: Tafuta umbo chumbani humu, kisha gusa linalolingana.
s04.math.lesson.04.steps.5.narration: Maumbo manne, na unaweza kuyataja yote.
s04.math.lesson.04.title: Maumbo manne
s04.math.lesson.05.steps.0.narration: Panga dubu mstarini: mdogo, wa kati, mkubwa.
s04.math.lesson.05.steps.2.narration: Sasa wapange upande mwingine: kubwa hadi dogo.
s04.math.lesson.05.steps.3.feedback: Wa wastani — si mkubwa, si mdogo.
s04.math.lesson.05.steps.3.narration: Dubu yupi yuko katikati? Gusa jibu lako.
s04.math.lesson.05.steps.4.feedback: Umepata nafasi yake kwa kulinganisha. Werevu!
s04.math.lesson.05.steps.4.narration: Ongeza dubu wa nne. Anaenda wapi?
s04.math.lesson.05.steps.5.narration: Kupanga ni kulinganisha, jozi moja kwa wakati.
s04.math.lesson.05.title: Panga kwa ukubwa

s04.math.lesson.06.steps.2.narration: Duara, mraba, duara, mraba. Gusa mbili zinazofuata.

s04.math.lesson.06.steps.3.narration: Hii ni ngumu zaidi: kubwa, kubwa, dogo. Kinachofuata? Gusa jibu lako.

s04.math.story.01.pages.0.narration: Katika Mji wa Maumbo, nyumba ni miraba.
s04.math.story.01.pages.1.narration: Jua ni duara na paa ni pembetatu.
s04.math.story.01.pages.2.narration: Katika mtaa mmoja: duara, mraba, pembetatu, duara, mraba...
s04.math.story.01.pages.3.narration: Hata magurudumu ya basi ni maduara.
s04.math.story.01.pages.4.narration: Hesabu maumbo unayoyaona. Mji uliojaa maumbo!
s04.math.story.01.parentNote: Baadaye tafuteni umbo moja la kila aina chumbani mwenu.
s04.math.story.01.title: Mji wa maumbo
s04.math.story.02.pages.0.narration: Juma alipata mawe matano na akayapanga.
s04.math.story.02.pages.1.narration: Dogo kwanza, kisha kubwa, kisha kubwa kuliko yote.
s04.math.story.02.pages.2.narration: Aligusa kila moja alipohesabu. Moja, mbili, tatu, nne, tano.
s04.math.story.02.pages.3.narration: Moja likavingirika. Manne yamebaki — bado mstari.
s04.math.story.02.pages.4.narration: Alilipata chini ya jani na akalirudisha. Matano tena.
s04.math.story.02.parentNote: Pangeni vitu vitano halisi na muvihesabu.
s04.math.story.02.title: Mawe Matano Mstarini
s04.science.lesson.01.steps.4.narration: Gusa mikono. Hiyo ni hisia ya tano.
s04.science.lesson.01.steps.5.feedback: Kugusa! Kila hisia ina kazi yake.
s04.science.lesson.01.steps.5.narration: Hisia ipi inakuambia mkate ni wa moto? Gusa jibu lako.
s04.science.lesson.01.title: Hisi tano
s04.science.lesson.02.parentNote: Angalieni dirishani na mtaje hali ya hewa ya leo.
s04.science.lesson.02.steps.3.narration: Gusa siku ya upepo. Ona miti ikiinama.
s04.science.lesson.02.steps.4.feedback: Mvua! Hali ya hewa hubadilisha tunachovaa.
s04.science.lesson.02.steps.4.narration: Hali gani ya hewa inahitaji mwavuli? Gusa jibu lako.
s04.science.lesson.02.steps.5.feedback: Umesoma anga halisi. Hiyo ni sayansi!
s04.science.lesson.02.steps.5.narration: Angalia nje. Gusa hali ya hewa ya leo.
s04.science.lesson.02.title: Hali ya hewa ikoje?
s04.science.lesson.03.steps.0.narration: Panda mbegu na uimwagilie maji. Gusa kumwagilia.
s04.science.lesson.03.steps.1.feedback: Chipukizi kidogo kinakua. Mimea inahitaji maji na jua!
s04.science.lesson.03.steps.2.narration: Subiri siku chache. Gusa uone ukikua mrefu.
s04.science.lesson.03.steps.3.feedback: Unanyauka. Mimea inahitaji maji kila wakati.
s04.science.lesson.03.steps.4.narration: Ni vitu vipi viwili kila mmea unahitaji? Gusa jibu lako.
s04.science.lesson.03.steps.5.feedback: Taratibu, na kwa uangalifu. Ndivyo ukuaji ulivyo.
s04.science.lesson.03.title: Jinsi mimea inavyokua
s04.science.lesson.04.steps.1.narration: Usiku tunaona mwezi na nyota. Viguse.
s04.science.lesson.04.steps.3.narration: Ungeona kipi wakati wa kulala? Gusa jibu lako.
s04.science.lesson.04.steps.4.narration: Ni mchana au usiku sasa hivi? Gusa.
s04.science.lesson.04.steps.5.feedback: Hugeuka kutoka moja hadi nyingine kila siku.
s04.science.lesson.04.steps.5.narration: Anga lile lile, nyuso mbili tofauti.
s04.science.lesson.04.title: Anga la mchana na usiku
s04.science.lesson.05.steps.0.narration: Mtoto wa mbwa. Vuta mtoto kwa mbwa.
s04.science.lesson.05.steps.1.narration: Mtoto wa paka. Mvute kwa paka.
s04.science.lesson.05.steps.2.narration: Mwana kondoo ni mwanakondoo. Mvute kwa kondoo.
s04.science.lesson.05.steps.3.feedback: Ndama! Kila mtoto ana umbo la ukubwani.
s04.science.lesson.05.steps.3.narration: Mtoto yupi atakua kuwa ng'ombe? Gusa jibu lako.
s04.science.lesson.05.steps.4.feedback: Chakula, joto na uangalizi. Kama wewe!
s04.science.lesson.05.steps.4.narration: Watoto wote wanahitaji nini kutoka kwa wakubwa? Gusa jibu lako.
s04.science.lesson.05.steps.5.feedback: Kila mnyama huanza mdogo, kama wewe.
s04.science.lesson.05.steps.5.narration: Watoto watatu wamelinganishwa na wakubwa watatu.
s04.science.lesson.05.title: Watoto wa wanyama
s04.science.lesson.06.steps.2.narration: Dondosha kizibo majini. Kigusa na uangalie.
s04.science.lesson.06.steps.3.narration: Sasa gusa sarafu ili uidondoshe ndani.
s04.science.lesson.06.steps.4.narration: Bahatisha kwanza, kisha gusa sifongo ili kidondoke.
s04.science.lesson.06.steps.5.feedback: Bahatisha, jaribu, gundua. Ndivyo sayansi ilivyo.
s04.science.lesson.06.steps.5.narration: Umejaribu vitu vinne na kubahatisha cha mwisho.
s04.science.lesson.06.title: Inaelea au inazama

s04.science.quiz.01.questions.2.correctF: Kwenye udongo, msituni. Mizizi inahitaji ardhi.
s04.science.quiz.01.questions.2.retryFee: Fikiria mahali mizizi inaweza kushikilia. Jaribu tena.
s04.science.quiz.01.title: Ninaishi wapi?
s04.science.quiz.02.questions.0.retryFee: Mimea hunywa na kunyonya jua. Jaribu tena!
s04.science.quiz.02.questions.1.retryFee: Ngoma hutoa sauti, si ukuaji. Jaribu tena.
s04.science.quiz.02.questions.2.correctF: Chini ya ardhi, gizani, kabla hatujaiona.
s04.science.quiz.02.questions.2.retryFee: Huanza mahali tusipoweza kuona. Jaribu tena.
s04.science.quiz.02.title: Mimea inahitaji nini?
s04.science.quiz.03.questions.1.retryFee: Samaki anahitaji maji kupumua. Jaribu tena.
s04.science.quiz.03.questions.2.prompt: Je, jiwe zito huelea au huzama?
s04.science.quiz.03.title: Inaishi majini
s04.science.quiz.04.parentNote: Mwagilieni mmea halisi baada ya hapa.
s04.science.quiz.04.questions.0.correctF: Maji! Jua na maji, kila wakati.
s04.science.quiz.04.questions.0.retryFee: Mimea haichezi na vichezeo. Jaribu tena!
s04.science.quiz.04.questions.1.retryFee: Bila maji hauwezi kukua kabisa. Jaribu tena!
s04.science.quiz.04.questions.2.correctF: Mrefu zaidi na wa kijani zaidi. Ndicho kilichohitajika.
s04.science.quiz.04.questions.2.prompt: Mmea hufanya nini ukipata jua na maji ya kutosha?
s04.science.quiz.04.questions.2.retryFee: Hicho hutokea bila maji. Jaribu tena.
s04.science.quiz.04.title: Mimea Inahitaji Nini?
s04.science.story.01.pages.0.narration: Tone-tone! Mvua inaanza kunyesha. Gusa kufungua mwavuli.
s04.science.story.01.pages.2.narration: Kisha mvua inapungua. Tone... tone... imekoma.
s04.science.story.01.pages.3.narration: Mawingu ya kijivu yanaachana. Anga la buluu tena!
s04.science.story.01.pages.4.narration: Jua linatoka na kutengeneza upinde wa mvua. Mzuri sana!
s04.science.story.01.parentNote: Mvua ikinyesha tena, tazameni anga halisi pamoja.
s04.science.story.01.title: Siku ya mvua
s04.science.story.02.pages.0.narration: Mbegu ilikaa udongoni gizani. Hakuna kilichotokea.
s04.science.story.02.pages.1.narration: Mvua ilikuja. Kisha jua. Bado hakuna, kwa siku nyingi.
s04.science.story.02.pages.2.narration: Chini ya udongo, pasipoonekana na mtu, mizizi ilikuwa ikitanda.
s04.science.story.02.pages.3.narration: Kisha asubuhi moja, chipukizi kidogo cha kijani.
s04.science.story.02.pages.4.narration: Kufikia wiki iliyofuata kilikuwa kirefu kuliko mkono wa Juma.
s04.science.story.02.parentNote: Pandeni mbegu halisi na muiangalie kila siku.
s04.science.story.02.title: Mbegu Iliyosubiri
s04.semotional.lesson.01.parentNote: Nyenzo nzuri kwa hisia kubwa — pumueni pamoja.
s04.semotional.lesson.01.steps.0.feedbac: Puto linajaa polepole na sauti laini.
s04.semotional.lesson.01.steps.0.narrati: Vuta pumzi ndani puto linapokua. Shika...
s04.semotional.lesson.01.steps.1.feedbac: Mlio wa utulivu. 'Umefanikiwa. Unahisi utulivu zaidi?'
s04.semotional.lesson.01.steps.1.narrati: Toa pumzi nje puto linapopungua. Aaa.
s04.semotional.lesson.01.steps.2.narrati: Pumzi moja zaidi ya taratibu ndani... na nje.
s04.semotional.lesson.01.steps.3.narrati: Sasa pumzi tatu peke yako. Zihesabu.
s04.semotional.lesson.01.steps.4.narrati: Hii ingesaidia lini? Gusa uso wa hasira.
s04.semotional.lesson.01.steps.5.narrati: Sasa una nyenzo, nayo huenda popote nawe.
s04.semotional.lesson.01.title: Kupumua ili kutulia
s04.semotional.lesson.02.steps.0.feedbac: Sasa wote wanaweza kucheza. Kushiriki ni wema!
s04.semotional.lesson.02.steps.0.narrati: Marafiki wawili, mpira mmoja. Gusa kuushiriki.
s04.semotional.lesson.02.steps.1.feedbac: Zamu yako, zamu yangu. Furaha kwa wote!
s04.semotional.lesson.02.steps.2.narrati: Sasa kuna marafiki watatu na mipira miwili. Gusa jibu lako.
s04.semotional.lesson.02.steps.3.feedbac: Mwalike ajiunge. Hilo ndilo jibu la wema.
s04.semotional.lesson.02.steps.3.narrati: Mtu ameachwa. Ungefanya nini? Gusa jibu lako.
s04.semotional.lesson.02.steps.4.narrati: Unajisikiaje mtu anaposhirikiana nawe? Gusa jibu lako.
s04.semotional.lesson.02.title: Kushiriki na marafiki
s04.semotional.lesson.03.steps.0.narrati: Hisia hii ni kuchanganyikiwa. Gusa uso.
s04.semotional.lesson.03.steps.3.narrati: Uso upi unalingana na kumaliza jambo gumu? Gusa jibu lako.
s04.semotional.lesson.03.steps.4.narrati: Uko karibu na upi sasa hivi? Gusa jibu lako.
s04.semotional.lesson.03.steps.5.feedbac: Hisia unayoweza kuitaja ni hisia unayoweza kuishughulikia.
s04.semotional.lesson.03.steps.5.narrati: Hisia nne, na sasa una maneno yake.
s04.semotional.lesson.03.title: Kutaja hisia kubwa
s04.semotional.lesson.04.parentNote: Msaidie mtoto wako kupata maneno ya kurekebisha baada ya ugomvi.
s04.semotional.lesson.04.steps.2.feedbac: Taratibu na kwa kweli. Hiyo ni samahani halisi.
s04.semotional.lesson.04.steps.2.narrati: Samahani hufanya kazi tunapoiamini. Gusa useme taratibu.
s04.semotional.lesson.04.steps.3.feedbac: Wape muda. Samahani ni mwanzo, si suluhisho.
s04.semotional.lesson.04.steps.3.narrati: Je, wakiendelea kuhuzunika baada ya samahani? Gusa jibu lako.
s04.semotional.lesson.04.steps.4.narrati: Kuna mtu amekuomba radhi? Gusa ulivyojisikia.
s04.semotional.lesson.04.steps.5.feedbac: Umefanya mazoezi ya sehemu ngumu leo.
s04.semotional.lesson.04.steps.5.narrati: Kuomba radhi kunahitaji ujasiri, si maneno tu.
s04.semotional.lesson.04.title: Kuomba msamaha
s04.semotional.lesson.05.steps.0.narrati: Rafiki ameangusha vifaa vyake. Gusa kumsaidia kuviokota.
s04.semotional.lesson.05.steps.2.narrati: Mtu hawezi kufikia kikombe. Gusa umsaidie.
s04.semotional.lesson.05.steps.3.feedbac: 'Ungependa msaada?' Kuuliza ni sehemu ya kusaidia.
s04.semotional.lesson.05.steps.3.narrati: Msaada mwingine hautakiwi. Uulize nini kwanza? Gusa jibu lako.
s04.semotional.lesson.05.steps.4.narrati: Ungemsaidia nani nyumbani leo? Gusa jibu lako.
s04.semotional.lesson.05.title: Mikono ya kusaidia
s04.semotional.lesson.06.steps.0.narrati: Picha-tatanishi ni ngumu. Vuta pumzi na ujaribu tena. Gusa kujaribu.
s04.semotional.lesson.06.steps.2.feedbac: Majaribio mawili. Huko si kukata tamaa!
s04.semotional.lesson.06.steps.2.narrati: Bado ni gumu. Vuta pumzi nyingine na ujaribu tena. Gusa jibu lako.
s04.semotional.lesson.06.steps.3.feedbac: Kuomba msaada. Huo ni ujasiri, si udhaifu.
s04.semotional.lesson.06.steps.3.narrati: Nini husaidia jambo linapokuwa gumu peke yako? Gusa jibu lako.
s04.semotional.lesson.06.steps.4.narrati: Fikiri jambo ambalo hukuweza mwaka jana. Gusa jibu lako.
s04.semotional.lesson.06.title: Ninaweza kuifanya
s04.semotional.quiz.01.questions.0.corre: Kupokezana zamu ni haki na wema!
s04.semotional.quiz.01.questions.0.promp: Marafiki wawili wanataka kifaa kile kile. Jambo gani la wema la kufanya?
s04.semotional.quiz.01.questions.0.retry: Marafiki wote wawili wanawezaje kuwa na furaha? Jaribu tena!
s04.semotional.quiz.01.questions.1.corre: Kumwalika ndiyo yote. Sasa mko wawili.
s04.semotional.quiz.01.questions.1.promp: Rafiki yako hana wa kucheza naye. Nini ni wema?
s04.semotional.quiz.01.questions.1.retry: Fikiria anavyojisikia akiwa peke yake. Jaribu tena.
s04.semotional.quiz.01.questions.2.corre: Zamu kwa kila mmoja. Ndiyo maana ya haki.
s04.semotional.quiz.01.questions.2.promp: Uko kwenye bembea na rafiki anasubiri. Nini ni haki?
s04.semotional.quiz.01.questions.2.retry: Ungependa kusubiri kwa muda gani? Jaribu tena.
s04.semotional.quiz.01.title: Kupokezana zamu
s04.semotional.quiz.02.questions.0.corre: Sawa kabisa. Kuvuta pumzi ndefu kunakusaidia kutulia!
s04.semotional.quiz.02.questions.0.promp: Nini kinaweza kusaidia unapokuwa na hasira?
s04.semotional.quiz.02.questions.2.corre: Tena. Kuanguka ni sehemu ya kujenga.
s04.semotional.quiz.02.title: Unapokuwa na hasira
s04.semotional.quiz.03.questions.0.promp: Rafiki yako ana huzuni. Unaweza kufanya nini?
s04.semotional.quiz.03.questions.1.corre: Kuwepo tu kunatosha. Huhitaji maneno sahihi.
s04.semotional.quiz.03.questions.1.promp: Nini kingine kinaweza kumsaidia rafiki mwenye huzuni?
s04.semotional.quiz.03.questions.2.corre: Hilo humruhusu alie bila kuwa peke yake.
s04.semotional.quiz.03.questions.2.promp: Rafiki yako analia. Ni jambo gani jema la kusema?
s04.semotional.quiz.03.questions.2.retry: Kumwambia mtu aache mara chache husaidia. Jaribu tena.
s04.semotional.quiz.03.title: Rafiki ana huzuni
s04.semotional.quiz.04.questions.1.promp: Na ikiwa bado ni ngumu peke yako?
s04.semotional.quiz.04.questions.1.retry: Kukata tamaa kunamaliza jaribio. Jaribu tena!
s04.semotional.quiz.04.questions.2.corre: Fahari. Kumbuka hisia hii wakati ujao litakapokuwa gumu.
s04.semotional.quiz.04.title: Nini Husaidia Inapokuwa Ngumu?
s04.semotional.story.01.pages.0.narratio: Sara na Kofi wote wanataka pembea.
s04.semotional.story.01.pages.3.narratio: Kusubiri kulikuwa rahisi zaidi ukiwa na mtu wa kuzungumza naye.
s04.semotional.story.01.pages.4.narratio: Sasa wanasukumana na kucheka. Marafiki wazuri hushiriki!
s04.semotional.story.01.parentNote: Zungumzeni kuhusu kinachomfanya mtu kuwa rafiki mzuri.
s04.semotional.story.01.title: Marafiki wa dhati
s04.semotional.story.02.pages.0.narratio: Neema alijenga mnara. Kwenye kizuizi cha tisa, ulianguka.
s04.semotional.story.02.pages.1.narratio: Uso wake ulipata joto. Alitaka kusukuma vyote mbali.
s04.semotional.story.02.pages.2.narratio: Alisimama. Ndani kwa pua, nje polepole kwa mdomo.
s04.semotional.story.02.pages.3.narratio: Kisha akaanza tena. Kizuizi kimoja, kisha viwili, kisha vitatu.
s04.semotional.story.02.pages.4.narratio: Kwenye kizuizi cha tisa, ulisimama. Tisa!
s04.semotional.story.02.title: Mnara Ulioanguka
s04.social.lesson.01.steps.4.feedback: Daktari au muuguzi. Umejua nani husaidia!
s04.social.lesson.01.steps.4.narration: Ungemwendea nani ukiwa na jeraha la goti? Gusa jibu lako.
s04.social.lesson.01.steps.5.feedback: Ni watu halisi katika mji wako.
s04.social.lesson.01.steps.5.narration: Msaidizi yupi umewahi kukutana naye maishani? Gusa jibu lako.
s04.social.lesson.01.title: Wasaidizi wa jamii
s04.social.lesson.02.parentNote: Zungumzeni kuhusu walio katika familia yako.
s04.social.lesson.02.steps.1.narration: Gusa mtoto mchanga na babu au bibi.
s04.social.lesson.02.steps.2.feedback: 'Baadhi ya familia zina watoto wengi, nyingine mmoja.'
s04.social.lesson.02.steps.3.feedback: Familia yako ina umbo sahihi kabisa.
s04.social.lesson.02.steps.3.narration: Nani anaishi nyumbani kwako? Wagusa wote.
s04.social.lesson.02.steps.4.narration: Familia yako hufanya nini pamoja? Gusa jibu lako.
s04.social.lesson.02.steps.5.narration: Familia huja kwa kila umbo lililopo.
s04.social.lesson.02.title: Familia yangu
s04.social.lesson.03.steps.1.feedback: 'Duka na bustani. Maeneo katika mji wetu.'
s04.social.lesson.03.steps.3.feedback: Maktaba! Kila mahali pana kazi yake.
s04.social.lesson.03.steps.3.narration: Ungekwenda wapi kuazima kitabu? Gusa jibu lako.
s04.social.lesson.03.steps.4.feedback: Mji wako umetengenezwa kwa maeneo kama haya.
s04.social.lesson.03.steps.4.narration: Ni sehemu ipi kati ya hizi umewahi kwenda? Gusa jibu lako.
s04.social.lesson.03.steps.5.feedback: Hiyo ni ramani, iliyoshikwa kichwani mwako.
s04.social.lesson.03.steps.5.narration: Umetaja maeneo manne na kazi ya kila moja.
s04.social.lesson.03.title: Maeneo katika mji wangu
s04.social.lesson.04.steps.4.feedback: Mashua. Kila njia ya kusafiri inafaa mahali.
s04.social.lesson.04.steps.4.narration: Kipi kingekuvusha bahari? Gusa jibu lako.
s04.social.lesson.04.steps.5.feedback: Hata kutembea ni njia ya kusafiri!
s04.social.lesson.04.title: Njia za kusafiri
s04.social.lesson.05.steps.0.narration: Kuomba kwa adabu, tunasema tafadhali. Gusa kusema tafadhali.
s04.social.lesson.05.steps.3.narration: Umegongana na mtu bila kukusudia. Sasa nini? Gusa jibu lako.
s04.social.lesson.05.steps.4.feedback: Kuisema kwa sauti ndiko kunakoifanya ihesabike.
s04.social.lesson.05.steps.4.narration: Ungemshukuru nani leo? Gusa jibu lako.
s04.social.lesson.05.steps.5.feedback: Maneno manne madogo yanayowafanya watu wajisikie vizuri.
s04.social.lesson.05.title: Kuwa mwema
s04.social.lesson.06.steps.0.narration: Taka huenda kwenye pipa, si chini. Gusa kusafisha.
s04.social.lesson.06.steps.1.narration: Tunaweza pia kuchakata. Gusa pipa la kuchakata.
s04.social.lesson.06.steps.2.narration: Zima bomba unapopiga mswaki. Gusa uokoe maji.
s04.social.lesson.06.steps.3.narration: Chupa hii inastahili wapi? Gusa jibu lako.
s04.social.lesson.06.steps.4.feedback: Chagua jambo moja na ulifanye kweli.
s04.social.lesson.06.steps.4.narration: Ungefanya nini kwa Dunia wiki hii? Gusa jibu lako.
s04.social.lesson.06.steps.5.narration: Mapipa, urejelezi, maji. Njia tatu za kusaidia.
s04.social.lesson.06.title: Kutunza Dunia yetu

s05.reading.lesson.06.steps.1.feedback: 'The cat is big!' Usomaji mzuri sana.
s05.reading.lesson.06.steps.3.feedback: 'see'. Kila sentensi ina neno la kutenda.
s05.reading.lesson.06.steps.3.narration: Neno lipi linakuambia ulichofanya? Gusa jibu lako.
s05.reading.lesson.06.steps.4.narration: Nini kipo mwishoni mwa kila sentensi? Gusa jibu lako.
s05.reading.lesson.06.steps.5.feedback: Herufi, kisha maneno, sasa sentensi. Hiyo ndiyo ngazi.
s05.reading.lesson.06.title: Soma sentensi

s05.reading.story.01.pages.0.narration: Paka aliketi juu ya mkeka. Gusa kusoma pamoja.
s05.reading.story.01.pages.1.narration: Paka alivaa kofia. Paka mnene kweli!
s05.reading.story.01.pages.2.narration: Kofia ilikaa sawa juu ya paka. Pah, pah!
s05.reading.story.01.pages.3.narration: Mkeka, kofia, paka, sawa — yote yanaishia vivyo hivyo.
s05.reading.story.01.parentNote: Isome mara mbili — mwache mtoto wako akamilishe maneno yanayosajiana.
s05.reading.story.01.title: Paka na kofia
s05.reading.story.02.pages.0.narration: Neno lilikaa ukurasani na halikutaka kuja.
s05.reading.story.02.pages.3.narration: Kisha nilizisema haraka, zote pamoja: b-e-d.
s05.reading.story.02.pages.4.narration: Bed. Lilikuwa bed muda wote. Nimelisoma mwenyewe.
s05.reading.story.02.parentNote: Waache watamke neno moja halisi kutoka kitabuni.
s05.reading.story.02.title: Neno Nisiloweza Kusoma
s05.science.lesson.01.recap.0.prompt: Je, mbwa ni kiumbe hai au si hai?
s05.science.lesson.01.recap.1.prompt: Jiwe halikui wala halili, kwa hivyo ni…
s05.science.lesson.01.steps.0.feedback: Kiumbe hai! Mbwa hukua, hula, na hupumua.
s05.science.lesson.01.steps.0.narration: Je, mbwa ni kiumbe hai au si hai?
s05.science.lesson.01.steps.1.feedback: Si hai. Jiwe halikui wala hauli.
s05.science.lesson.01.steps.1.narration: Je, jiwe ni kiumbe hai au si hai?
s05.science.lesson.01.steps.2.feedback: Hai! Unakua na kunywa, hata bila kusogea.
s05.science.lesson.01.steps.2.narration: Mti ni hai au si hai? Gusa jibu lako.
s05.science.lesson.01.steps.3.feedback: Hapana. Kusogea hakutoshi — lazima ukue na ule.
s05.science.lesson.01.steps.3.narration: Mbwa wa kuchezea husogea na kutoa sauti. Ni hai? Gusa jibu lako.
s05.science.lesson.01.steps.4.feedback: Chakula, maji na hewa. Vyote vitatu, daima.
s05.science.lesson.01.steps.4.narration: Viumbe vyote hai vinahitaji nini? Gusa jibu lako.
s05.science.lesson.01.steps.5.feedback: Sasa una kipimo unachoweza kutumia kwa chochote.
s05.science.lesson.01.steps.5.narration: Viumbe hai hukua, hula na hupumua.
s05.science.lesson.01.title: Hai au si hai
s05.science.lesson.02.steps.0.narration: Maua huchanua wakati wa masika. Gusa masika.
s05.science.lesson.02.steps.1.narration: Gusa kiangazi cha joto, kisha pukutiko lenye majani, kisha baridi yenye theluji.
s05.science.lesson.02.steps.2.feedback: Vuli. Misimu huenda kwa mpangilio ule ule.
s05.science.lesson.02.steps.3.feedback: Baridi. Hali ya hewa hubadilisha tunachovaa.
s05.science.lesson.02.steps.3.narration: Msimu upi ungehitaji koti la joto? Gusa jibu lako.
s05.science.lesson.02.steps.4.narration: Ni msimu upi ulipo sasa? Gusa jibu lako.
s05.science.lesson.02.steps.5.feedback: Baada ya baridi, majira ya kuchipua hurudi daima.
s05.science.lesson.02.title: Misimu minne
s05.science.lesson.03.parentNote: Angalieni mmea halisi na mtaje sehemu zake.
s05.science.lesson.03.recap.0.prompt: Ni sehemu ipi ya mmea inayonywa maji chini ya ardhi?
s05.science.lesson.03.recap.1.prompt: Ni kipi kati ya hivi ni sehemu ya mmea?
s05.science.lesson.03.steps.0.narration: Mizizi hunywa maji ardhini. Gusa mizizi.
s05.science.lesson.03.steps.2.feedback: Mizizi. Hufanya kazi chini ambako huoni.
s05.science.lesson.03.steps.3.feedback: Hubeba maji juu, na hushikilia mmea wima.
s05.science.lesson.03.steps.3.narration: Shina hufanya nini? Gusa jibu lako.
s05.science.lesson.03.steps.4.feedback: Sehemu zile zile, kila mmea utakaokutana nao.
s05.science.lesson.03.steps.4.narration: Tafuta sehemu hizi kwenye mmea halisi karibu.
s05.science.lesson.03.steps.5.narration: Mizizi, shina, jani, ua. Kazi nne, mmea mmoja.
s05.science.lesson.03.title: Sehemu za mmea
s05.science.lesson.04.steps.0.narration: Ndege anaishi kwenye kiota. Mvute ndege kwa kiota.
s05.science.lesson.04.steps.1.narration: Dubu anaishi pangoni; buibui kwenye utando.
s05.science.lesson.04.steps.3.feedback: Kubaki salama na joto — sababu zile zile kama wewe.
s05.science.lesson.04.steps.3.narration: Kwa nini wanyama hujenga nyumba? Gusa jibu lako.
s05.science.lesson.04.steps.4.feedback: Kila mnyama hujenga kinachofaa mahali anapoishi.
s05.science.lesson.04.steps.4.narration: Ungejijengea nyumba ipi? Gusa jibu lako.
s05.science.lesson.04.steps.5.feedback: Hakuna iliyo kosa — ni tofauti tu.
s05.science.lesson.04.steps.5.narration: Kiota, pango, utando, shimo. Nyumba nne, maisha manne.
s05.science.lesson.04.title: Makazi ya wanyama
s05.science.lesson.05.recap.0.prompt: Ni kipi kinachosogeza kitu mbali nawe?
s05.science.lesson.05.steps.0.narration: Kufungua mlango mbali nawe, tunasukuma au kuvuta?
s05.science.lesson.05.steps.2.narration: Kusogeza sanduku mbali nawe — kusukuma au kuvuta? Gusa jibu lako.
s05.science.lesson.05.steps.3.feedback: Msukumo mkali huisogeza mbali zaidi. Nguvu ina ukubwa!
s05.science.lesson.05.steps.3.narration: Kipi ni chenye nguvu: msukumo mpole au mkali? Gusa jibu lako.
s05.science.lesson.05.steps.4.feedback: Mlango ule ule, nguvu mbili kinyume.
s05.science.lesson.05.steps.4.narration: Sukuma mlango halisi, kisha uvute. Hisi tofauti.
s05.science.lesson.05.title: Sukuma na vuta
s05.science.lesson.06.steps.0.narration: Baridi hugeuza maji kuwa barafu. Gusa friji.
s05.science.lesson.06.steps.2.narration: Acha barafu juani. Nini hutokea? Gusa jibu lako.
s05.science.lesson.06.steps.3.feedback: Ndiyo! Mbele na nyuma, mara nyingi upendavyo.
s05.science.lesson.06.steps.3.narration: Je, maji yanaweza kuwa barafu tena baada ya kuyeyuka? Gusa jibu lako.
s05.science.lesson.06.steps.4.feedback: Maji yale yale, yakiwa na umbo tofauti.
s05.science.lesson.06.steps.4.narration: Barafu iliyoyeyuka ni kitu tofauti, au maji yale yale? Gusa jibu lako.
s05.science.lesson.06.steps.5.feedback: Kitu kimoja, hali mbili. Hilo ni wazo kubwa la sayansi.
s05.science.lesson.06.steps.5.narration: Baridi huifanya ngumu; joto huifanya inayotiririka.
s05.science.lesson.06.title: Barafu na maji
s05.science.quiz.01.questions.0.correctF: Kinaelea! Kizibo ni chepesi kwa ukubwa wake.
s05.science.quiz.01.questions.0.retryFee: Vitu vyepesi mara nyingi huelea. Jaribu tena!
s05.science.quiz.01.questions.1.correctF: Unazama. Chuma ni kizito na kinene.
s05.science.quiz.01.questions.1.prompt: Je, ufunguo wa chuma utaelea au utazama?
s05.science.quiz.01.questions.1.retryFee: Vitu vizito na vinene huzama. Jaribu tena!
s05.science.quiz.01.questions.2.correctF: Litaelea. Vitu vyepesi hukaa juu ya maji.
s05.science.quiz.01.questions.2.prompt: Je, jani kavu litaelea au litazama?
s05.science.quiz.01.questions.2.retryFee: Fikiria uzito wa jani. Jaribu tena.
s05.science.quiz.01.title: Inazama au inaelea?
s05.science.quiz.02.questions.0.retryFee: Viumbe hai hukua na huhitaji maji. Jaribu tena!
s05.science.quiz.02.questions.1.correctF: Paka. Hula, hukua na husogea wenyewe.
s05.science.quiz.02.questions.1.prompt: Paka na kiti. Kipi kiko hai?
s05.science.quiz.02.questions.1.retryFee: Kipi kingeweza kusikia njaa? Jaribu tena.
s05.science.quiz.02.questions.2.correctF: Kukua na kuhitaji vitu ndio kipimo. Rangi si kipimo.
s05.science.quiz.02.questions.2.retryFee: Kiti cha kijani hakiishi. Jaribu tena.
s05.science.quiz.02.title: Kipi ni hai?
s05.science.quiz.03.questions.0.retryFee: Ni lini kuna baridi zaidi? Jaribu tena!
s05.science.quiz.03.questions.1.correctF: Kiangazi. Siku ndefu na jua la joto.
s05.science.quiz.03.questions.1.retryFee: Huo ndio wa baridi. Jaribu tena.
s05.science.quiz.03.questions.2.prompt: Ni msimu upi majani huanguka kutoka miti?
s05.science.quiz.03.questions.2.retryFee: Huo ndio wakati majani mapya huota. Jaribu tena.
s05.science.quiz.03.title: Msimu wa theluji
s05.science.quiz.04.questions.0.retryFee: Hukua, kwa hiyo ni hai. Jaribu tena!
s05.science.quiz.04.questions.2.retryFee: Je, anahitaji chakula ili aendelee kuishi? Jaribu tena.
s05.science.quiz.04.title: Hai au La?
s05.science.story.01.pages.0.narration: Mbegu ndogo inalala udongoni. Gusa kuipa mvua.
s05.science.story.01.pages.1.narration: Chini ya ardhi, mizizi inashuka, ikitafuta maji.
s05.science.story.01.pages.2.narration: Kwa jua na maji, chipukizi la kijani linachomoza!
s05.science.story.01.pages.3.narration: Majani yanafunguka, jozi moja baada ya nyingine, yakinywa mwanga.
s05.science.story.01.pages.4.narration: Linakua hadi kuwa ua. Viumbe hai hukua!
s05.science.story.01.parentNote: Angalia mbegu halisi inayochipua saa ile ile kila siku.
s05.science.story.01.title: Mbegu ndogo
s05.science.story.02.pages.0.narration: Asubuhi kulikuwa na dimbwi pana, linalong'aa.
s05.science.story.02.pages.1.narration: Kufikia mchana lilikuwa mstari mwembamba tu, wenye unyevu.
s05.science.story.02.pages.2.narration: Maji yanaweza kuwa barafu, au dimbwi, au kitu usichokiona.
s05.science.story.02.pages.3.narration: Jioni, jiwe kavu. Maji yalipanda hewani.
s05.science.story.02.pages.4.narration: Siku moja yanaanguka tena kama mvua, na dimbwi linarudi.
s05.science.story.02.parentNote: Angalieni dimbwi halisi siku moja ya jua.
s05.science.story.02.title: Dimbwi Lilikoenda
s05.social.lesson.01.recap.0.prompt: Kwenye ramani, sehemu ya buluu inaonyesha nini?
s05.social.lesson.01.recap.1.prompt: Kwenye ramani, sehemu ya kijani inaonyesha nini?
s05.social.lesson.01.steps.0.narration: Gusa sehemu ya buluu. Ni nini?
s05.social.lesson.01.steps.2.narration: Gusa kisiwa — nchi kavu iliyozungukwa na maji.
s05.social.lesson.01.steps.3.feedback: Kwa mashua au ndege. Ramani inakuambia jinsi ya kusafiri.
s05.social.lesson.01.steps.4.feedback: Maji zaidi. Ni kweli kwa dunia halisi pia.
s05.social.lesson.01.steps.4.narration: Kuna nchi kavu zaidi au maji zaidi kwenye ramani hii? Gusa jibu lako.
s05.social.lesson.01.steps.5.narration: Bluu ni maji, kijani ni nchi kavu. Ramani ya rangi mbili.
s05.social.lesson.01.title: Nchi kavu na maji
s05.social.lesson.02.parentNote: Zungumzeni kuhusu sheria nyumbani na jinsi inavyosaidia.
s05.social.lesson.02.recap.0.prompt: Kwa nini tunashikana mikono tunapovuka barabara?
s05.social.lesson.02.recap.1.options.0: Ili tuwe salama na wa haki
s05.social.lesson.02.steps.0.narration: Tunashikana mikono kuvuka barabara. Gusa kuvuka salama.
s05.social.lesson.02.steps.1.narration: Tunapokezana zamu kwenye telezo. Kwa nini? Kuwa salama na haki.
s05.social.lesson.02.steps.2.narration: Tunavaa kofia ngumu tukiwa baiskeli. Gusa kofia.
s05.social.lesson.02.steps.3.feedback: Ili kila mtu apate zamu ya haki.
s05.social.lesson.02.steps.3.narration: Kwa nini tunapanga mstari badala ya kusukumana? Gusa jibu lako.
s05.social.lesson.02.steps.4.feedback: Kanuni hutofautiana kila nyumba, na hiyo ni sawa.
s05.social.lesson.02.steps.4.narration: Ni kanuni ipi moja nyumbani kwako? Gusa jibu lako.
s05.social.lesson.02.steps.5.feedback: Salama na haki, kwa kila mtu.
s05.social.lesson.02.steps.5.narration: Kanuni si za kuzuia furaha. Huifanya iendelee.
s05.social.lesson.02.title: Kwa nini tuna sheria
s05.social.lesson.03.recap.0.prompt: Chakula na maji ni vitu tunavyo…
s05.social.lesson.03.recap.1.prompt: Kichezeo ni kizuri kuwa nacho, kwa hivyo ni…
s05.social.lesson.03.steps.0.narration: Tunahitaji chakula na maji ili kuishi. Vuta chakula kwenye sanduku la 'hitaji'.
s05.social.lesson.03.steps.1.narration: Kifaa cha kuchezea ni kizuri, lakini ni tamanio.
s05.social.lesson.03.steps.2.narration: Maji nayo huenda kwenye sanduku la 'hitaji'. Yavute.
s05.social.lesson.03.steps.3.feedback: Hitaji — hukuweka salama dhidi ya baridi.
s05.social.lesson.03.steps.3.narration: Je, koti la joto wakati wa baridi ni hitaji au tamaa? Gusa jibu lako.
s05.social.lesson.03.steps.4.feedback: Kutamani ni sawa. Kujua tofauti ndiko muhimu.
s05.social.lesson.03.steps.4.narration: Taja hitaji moja na tamaa moja yako. Gusa jibu lako.
s05.social.lesson.03.steps.5.feedback: Vyote ni halisi. Kimoja tu ni lazima.
s05.social.lesson.03.title: Mahitaji na matamanio
s05.social.lesson.04.steps.0.narration: Mkulima hulima chakula chetu. Gusa mkulima.
s05.social.lesson.04.steps.1.narration: Gusa muuguzi na dereva wa basi.
s05.social.lesson.04.steps.3.narration: Kazi ya nani inakusaidia kufika shuleni? Gusa jibu lako.
s05.social.lesson.04.steps.4.feedback: Unaweza kubadilisha mawazo mara nyingi upendavyo.
s05.social.lesson.04.steps.4.narration: Ungependa kujaribu kazi gani siku moja? Gusa jibu lako.
s05.social.lesson.04.steps.5.narration: Kila kazi hapa hushikilia siku ya mtu mwingine.
s05.social.lesson.04.title: Kazi watu wanazofanya
s05.social.lesson.05.parentNote: Mwonyeshe mtoto wako bendera ya nchi yenu na rangi zake.
s05.social.lesson.05.steps.0.narration: Kila nchi ina bendera. Gusa kupeperusha moja.
s05.social.lesson.05.steps.1.narration: Bendera zina rangi na maumbo. Kuna nini kwenye yako?
s05.social.lesson.05.steps.2.feedback: Nyota, mistari, miduara — bendera hutumia maumbo.
s05.social.lesson.05.steps.3.feedback: Ili watu waitambue na wahisi ni yao.
s05.social.lesson.05.steps.3.narration: Kwa nini nchi huwa na bendera? Gusa jibu lako.
s05.social.lesson.05.steps.4.feedback: Rangi zako, maumbo yako, chaguo lako.
s05.social.lesson.05.steps.4.narration: Chora bendera ya familia yako. Kuna nini juu yake? Gusa jibu lako.
s05.social.lesson.05.steps.5.feedback: Kila nchi ina yake, na sasa nawe unayo.
s05.social.lesson.05.steps.5.narration: Bendera ni picha inayosema 'hawa ni sisi'.
s05.social.lesson.05.title: Bendera yangu
s05.social.lesson.06.steps.0.narration: Zamani, watu walipanda farasi. Gusa farasi.
s05.social.lesson.06.steps.1.feedback: Leo! Mambo hubadilika kadri ya wakati.
s05.social.lesson.06.steps.2.feedback: Siku za kutembea kwa ujumbe mmoja!
s05.social.lesson.06.steps.2.narration: Zamani, barua zilipelekwa kwa mkono. Gusa mjumbe.
s05.social.lesson.06.steps.3.feedback: Sekunde moja. Hayo ni mabadiliko makubwa sana.
s05.social.lesson.06.steps.3.narration: Ujumbe huchukua muda gani leo? Gusa jibu lako.
s05.social.lesson.06.steps.4.narration: Muulize mtu mzima kilichokuwa tofauti alipokuwa mdogo. Gusa jibu lako.
s05.social.lesson.06.steps.5.feedback: Dunia inaendelea kubadilika, nawe upo ndani yake.
s05.social.lesson.06.steps.5.narration: Vitu vinavyoonekana vya kawaida sasa vilikuwa vipya.
s05.social.lesson.06.title: Zamani na leo

s06.reading.quiz.04.questions.2.correctF: Manne. Nafasi huonyesha kila neno linapoishia.
s06.reading.quiz.04.questions.2.prompt: Soma mstari huu: 'We go to school.' Maneno mangapi?
s06.reading.quiz.04.questions.2.retryFee: Hesabu nafasi kati yao. Jaribu tena!
s06.reading.quiz.04.questions.3.correctF: Sahihi. Kutamka 'you' herufi kwa herufi hakufanyi kazi.
s06.reading.quiz.04.questions.3.prompt: Kwa nini tunajifunza maneno ya kuona kwa umbo?
s06.reading.quiz.04.questions.3.retryFee: Jaribu kutamka 'you' herufi kwa herufi. Jaribu tena!
s06.reading.quiz.04.title: Maneno ya Kuona
s06.reading.story.01.pages.0.narration: Sam ana kofia nyekundu. (Gusa neno lolote ulisikie.)
s06.reading.story.01.pages.4.narration: Sam anaketi juu ya mkeka na kusubiri.
s06.reading.story.01.pages.5.narration: Sam na paka wanakaa juu ya mkeka. Mwisho!
s06.reading.story.01.parentNote: Kila neno hapa linaweza kutamkwa isipokuwa 'the'. Waache wafanye kazi na uingilie kwa hilo tu.
s06.reading.story.01.title: Sam na Kofia Nyekundu
s06.reading.story.02.pages.0.narration: Ndani ya banda kuna meli. Ni ndogo na ni nyekundu.
s06.reading.story.02.pages.1.narration: Chad anaipata meli. 'Je, inaweza kwenda majini?' anauliza.
s06.reading.story.02.pages.2.narration: Kuna ufa kwenye meli. Maji yanaingia.
s06.reading.story.02.pages.3.narration: Chad anapata kiraka. Anakiweka juu ya ufa.
s06.reading.story.02.pages.4.narration: Meli inakaa juu ya maji. Haizami!
s06.reading.story.02.pages.5.narration: Chad na meli wanapanda mtoni. Shhh — wanaondoka.
s06.reading.story.02.parentNote: Hesabu maneno ya 'sh' na 'ch' pamoja mnaposoma mara ya pili. Kuwinda sauti hukaza haraka kuliko kuirudia.
s06.reading.story.02.title: Meli Ndani ya Banda
s06.science.lesson.01.recap.0.prompt: Barafu ni ngumu na hushika umbo lake. Ni hali ipi?
s06.science.lesson.01.recap.1.prompt: Mvuke huelea hewani. Ni hali ipi?
s06.science.lesson.01.steps.0.narration: Barafu ni ngumu. Iko katika hali gani?
s06.science.lesson.01.steps.3.narration: Tazama: vitu vigumu hushika umbo lake, viowevu humwagika, gesi huelea.
s06.science.lesson.01.steps.4.narration: Jiwe lipo mkononi mwako na linashika umbo lake. Gusa gumu.
s06.science.lesson.01.steps.5.narration: Maziwa kwenye kikombe huchukua umbo la kikombe. Gusa kiowevu.
s06.science.lesson.01.steps.6.narration: Barafu siku ya joto hugeuka maji. Gusa kilichokuwa.
s06.science.lesson.01.steps.7.narration: Gumu, kiowevu, gesi — maji yale yale yanaweza kuwa yote matatu.
s06.science.lesson.01.title: Kigumu, kiowevu, gesi
s06.science.lesson.02.recap.0.prompt: Ni vitu vipi viwili wanyama wanahitaji ili kuishi?
s06.science.lesson.02.steps.0.narration: Wanyama wanahitaji chakula na maji. Gusa chakula na maji.
s06.science.lesson.02.steps.2.feedback: Hewa ya kupumua. Kila mnyama anaihitaji!
s06.science.lesson.02.steps.2.narration: Wanyama wanahitaji hewa pia. Gusa upepo.
s06.science.lesson.02.steps.3.feedback: Mahitaji, si matamanio. Kichezeo si hitaji.
s06.science.lesson.02.steps.3.narration: Tazama: chakula, maji, hewa, makazi. Mahitaji manne, kila mnyama.
s06.science.lesson.02.steps.4.narration: Ndege hujenga kiota. Gusa hitaji linalotimizwa.
s06.science.lesson.02.steps.5.feedback: Maji! Mto ni nyumba yake na kinywaji chake.
s06.science.lesson.02.steps.5.narration: Samaki anaishi mtoni. Gusa anachochukua kutoka humo.
s06.science.lesson.02.steps.6.feedback: Mpira ni furaha, lakini hakuna kiumbe kinachoishi kwa mpira.
s06.science.lesson.02.steps.6.narration: Kipi si hitaji: maji, chakula, au mpira? Gusa mpira.
s06.science.lesson.02.steps.7.narration: Kila mnyama anahitaji vitu vinne vile vile.
s06.science.lesson.02.title: Wanyama wanahitaji nini
s06.science.lesson.03.recap.0.prompt: Ni nini hutupa mchana na joto?
s06.science.lesson.03.steps.0.narration: Jua hutupa mchana na joto. Gusa jua.
s06.science.lesson.03.steps.1.narration: Mwezi na nyota huangaza usiku. Viguse.
s06.science.lesson.03.steps.2.feedback: Nyota yetu wenyewe. Ndiyo maana inaonekana kubwa hivyo!
s06.science.lesson.03.steps.2.narration: Jua ni nyota, iliyo karibu sana nasi. Gusa jua.
s06.science.lesson.03.steps.3.feedback: Dunia huzunguka, hivyo mchana hufuata usiku.
s06.science.lesson.03.steps.3.narration: Tazama: jua huangaza mchana, mwezi huangaza usiku.
s06.science.lesson.03.steps.4.narration: Nyota zipo juu mchana pia, zimefichwa na mwanga wa jua. Gusa anga.
s06.science.lesson.03.steps.5.feedback: Mwezi ule ule, ukiangazwa kwa pembe mpya.
s06.science.lesson.03.steps.5.narration: Mwezi hubadilika umbo katika mwezi mzima. Gusa mwezi wa usiku huu.
s06.science.lesson.03.steps.6.feedback: Jua. Mwezi hauna joto lake mwenyewe.
s06.science.lesson.03.steps.6.narration: Kipi hutupa joto: jua au mwezi? Gusa jua.
s06.science.lesson.03.steps.7.feedback: Tazama juu usiku huu na upate moja.
s06.science.lesson.03.steps.7.narration: Jua, mwezi na nyota — unaweza kutaja anga.
s06.science.lesson.03.title: Jua, mwezi, nyota
s06.science.lesson.04.parentNote: Chagueni nguo pamoja kulingana na hali ya hewa ya leo.
s06.science.lesson.04.recap.0.prompt: Unavaa nini siku ya baridi na theluji?
s06.science.lesson.04.recap.1.prompt: Unavaa nini siku ya joto na jua?
s06.science.lesson.04.steps.0.narration: Kuna baridi na theluji. Vuta koti la joto.
s06.science.lesson.04.steps.1.narration: Kuna joto na jua. Vuta kofia ya jua.
s06.science.lesson.04.steps.3.feedback: Mavazi ndiyo njia ya watu kukabiliana na anga.
s06.science.lesson.04.steps.3.narration: Tazama: tunavaa kulingana na hali ya hewa ili mwili ustarehe.
s06.science.lesson.04.steps.4.narration: Kuna upepo na baridi leo. Buruta skafu.
s06.science.lesson.04.steps.5.feedback: Umesoma hali ya hewa ya leo na kuchagua. Hiyo ni sayansi!
s06.science.lesson.04.steps.5.narration: Tazama nje sasa. Gusa koti au kofia kwa leo.
s06.science.lesson.04.steps.6.narration: Je, ungevaa koti la joto siku ya jua kali? Gusa hapana.
s06.science.lesson.04.steps.7.narration: Hali ya hewa hubadilika, na sisi pia.
s06.science.lesson.04.title: Hali ya hewa na nguo
s06.science.lesson.05.recap.0.prompt: Kiti kinaweza kutengenezwa kwa nyenzo ipi?
s06.science.lesson.05.recap.1.prompt: Kijiko mara nyingi hutengenezwa kwa nyenzo ipi?
s06.science.lesson.05.steps.0.narration: Kiti kinaweza kuwa cha mbao. Gusa mbao.
s06.science.lesson.05.steps.1.narration: Kijiko kinaweza kuwa cha chuma; kikombe cha plastiki. Viguse.
s06.science.lesson.05.steps.2.feedback: Kioo! Tunaweza kuona ndani yake moja kwa moja.
s06.science.lesson.05.steps.2.narration: Kioo ni chenye kuangaza na kigumu. Gusa dirisha la kioo.
s06.science.lesson.05.steps.3.feedback: Kiti kinaweza kuwa mbao, chuma na kitambaa kwa pamoja.
s06.science.lesson.05.steps.3.narration: Tazama: kiti kimoja kinaweza kutengenezwa kwa mbao, chuma na kitambaa kwa pamoja.
s06.science.lesson.05.steps.4.narration: Karatasi hutoka kwenye miti, kama mbao. Gusa karatasi.
s06.science.lesson.05.steps.5.narration: Kitambaa ni laini na hupinda. Gusa taulo ya kitambaa.
s06.science.lesson.05.steps.6.feedback: Kioo. Vitu huchaguliwa kulingana na kazi.
s06.science.lesson.05.steps.6.narration: Ungetumia kipi kwa dirisha: mbao au kioo? Gusa kioo.
s06.science.lesson.05.steps.7.feedback: Sasa unaweza kutaja vitu vimetengenezwa kwa nini.
s06.science.lesson.05.steps.7.narration: Kila kikombe, kiti na kitabu kimetengenezwa kwa kitu fulani.
s06.science.lesson.05.title: Kimetengenezwa kwa nini?
s06.science.lesson.06.steps.0.narration: Gari la mbio huenda haraka. Liguse.
s06.science.lesson.06.steps.2.feedback: Duma. Mwenye kasi zaidi nchi kavu!
s06.science.lesson.06.steps.2.narration: Duma hukimbia kwa kasi. Kobe hutembea polepole. Gusa mwenye kasi.
s06.science.lesson.06.steps.3.feedback: Kasi ni umbali na muda kwa pamoja.
s06.science.lesson.06.steps.3.narration: Tazama: kasi maana yake umbali zaidi kwa muda ule ule.
s06.science.lesson.06.steps.4.feedback: Kukimbia! Miguu ile ile, kasi zaidi.
s06.science.lesson.06.steps.4.narration: Unatembea, kisha unakimbia. Gusa yenye kasi zaidi.
s06.science.lesson.06.steps.5.narration: Mto hutiririka kwa kasi baada ya mvua na polepole wakati wa ukame. Gusa mto wenye kasi.
s06.science.lesson.06.steps.6.narration: Kipi ni polepole: konokono au baiskeli? Gusa konokono.
s06.science.lesson.06.steps.7.narration: Kasi na polepole — unaweza kulinganisha vitu vyovyote viwili.
s06.science.lesson.06.title: Haraka na polepole
s06.science.quiz.01.parentNote: Makundi hufafanuliwa kwa sifa za mwili, si mahali mnyama anapoishi. Nyangumi huogelea lakini bado ni mnyama anayenyonyesha.
s06.science.quiz.01.questions.0.correctF: Mbwa ni mnyama anayenyonyesha. Wana manyoya na hunyonyesha.
s06.science.quiz.01.questions.0.retryFee: Je, mbwa ana manyoya? Jaribu tena!
s06.science.quiz.01.questions.1.retryFee: Manyoya na mabawa maana yake... jaribu tena!
s06.science.quiz.01.questions.2.correctF: Watambaazi. Nyoka na mjusi wote wapo humo.
s06.science.quiz.01.questions.2.prompt: Kundi lipi la wanyama lina magamba na hutaga mayai nchi kavu?
s06.science.quiz.01.questions.2.retryFee: Fikiria nyoka. Ngozi yake ikoje? Jaribu tena!
s06.science.quiz.01.questions.3.correctF: Anayenyonyesha. Hupumua hewa na kunyonyesha watoto wake.
s06.science.quiz.01.questions.3.prompt: Nyangumi anaishi baharini. Je, ni samaki?
s06.science.quiz.01.questions.3.retryFee: Mahali mnyama anapoishi si kundi lake. Jaribu tena!
s06.science.quiz.01.title: Mnyama, Ndege, Mtambaazi, au Samaki?
s06.science.quiz.02.parentNote: Tofauti ya mahitaji na matamanio ndilo somo zima. Mnyama wa nyumbani ni mahali pazuri pa kuifanya halisi.
s06.science.quiz.02.questions.0.retryFee: Hawawezi kuishi bila nini? Jaribu tena!
s06.science.quiz.02.questions.1.correctF: Makazi. Mahali salama kwa mayai na vifaranga.
s06.science.quiz.02.questions.1.retryFee: Je, kiota ni kitu cha kula? Jaribu tena!
s06.science.quiz.02.questions.2.correctF: Kichezeo ni kizuri, lakini hakuna kiumbe kinachoishi kwacho.
s06.science.quiz.02.questions.2.retryFee: Ungeweza kuishi bila kipi? Jaribu tena!
s06.science.quiz.02.questions.3.correctF: Manne: chakula, maji, hewa na makazi.
s06.science.quiz.02.questions.3.retryFee: Chakula, maji, hewa na kimoja zaidi. Jaribu tena!
s06.science.quiz.02.title: Mahitaji ya Wanyama
s06.science.quiz.03.parentNote: Vitu huchaguliwa kwa kazi — kioo kuona ndani, kitambaa kuwa laini. Uliza kwa nini, si nini tu.
s06.science.quiz.03.questions.0.retryFee: Kipi hutoka kwenye mti? Jaribu tena!
s06.science.quiz.03.questions.1.prompt: Kwa nini tunatengeneza madirisha kwa kioo?
s06.science.quiz.03.questions.1.retryFee: Unaweza kufanya nini kupitia dirisha? Jaribu tena!
s06.science.quiz.03.questions.2.correctF: Miti. Karatasi ni mbao, iliyosagwa na kukaushwa.
s06.science.quiz.03.questions.2.retryFee: Mbao na karatasi hutoka mahali pale pale. Jaribu tena!
s06.science.quiz.03.questions.3.correctF: Kitambaa. Laini, chenye joto, na hupinda nawe.
s06.science.quiz.03.questions.3.prompt: Ungechagua kitu kipi kwa koti la joto?
s06.science.quiz.03.questions.3.retryFee: Ungependa kipi kigusane na ngozi yako? Jaribu tena!
s06.science.quiz.03.title: Kimetengenezwa kwa Nini?
s06.science.quiz.04.parentNote: Maji ni mfano bora kwa sababu mtoto anaweza kuyaona yakiwa hali zote tatu. Barafu kwenye glasi yenye joto hufanya somo zima.
s06.science.quiz.04.questions.0.prompt: Barafu ni ngumu na hushika umbo lake. Ni hali gani?
s06.science.quiz.04.questions.0.retryFee: Unaweza kuishika bila kikombe? Jaribu tena!
s06.science.quiz.04.questions.1.correctF: Kiowevu. Humwagika na kujaza chochote kinachokishika.
s06.science.quiz.04.questions.1.prompt: Maziwa huchukua umbo la kikombe chake. Ni hali gani?
s06.science.quiz.04.questions.1.retryFee: Je, hushika umbo lake mwenyewe? Jaribu tena!
s06.science.quiz.04.questions.2.prompt: Mvuke unapanda kutoka kwenye sufuria moto. Ni hali gani?
s06.science.quiz.04.questions.3.correctF: Bado ni maji. Joto limebadilisha hali, si dutu yake.
s06.science.quiz.04.questions.3.retryFee: Igandishe tena — unapata nini? Jaribu tena!

s06.science.story.01.pages.0.narration: Jua linapasha ziwa joto. Maji yanapanda kama ukungu usioonekana.
s06.science.story.01.pages.1.narration: Juu hewa ni baridi. Ukungu unarudi kuwa matone madogo.
s06.science.story.01.pages.2.narration: Matone milioni pamoja hufanya wingu. Wingu linakuwa zito.
s06.science.story.01.pages.3.narration: Zito mno kuelea. Tone-tone — mvua inanyesha chini!
s06.science.story.01.pages.4.narration: Mvua inaingia mtoni, na mto unaingia ziwani.
s06.science.story.01.pages.5.narration: Kisha jua linapasha ziwa joto tena. Maji yanazunguka na kuzunguka.
s06.science.story.01.parentNote: Tazameni mawingu na mvua pamoja na zungumzeni kuhusu mzunguko. Birika lenye mvuke au dirisha baridi huonyesha hivyo hivyo ndani.
s06.science.story.01.title: Mvua Hutoka Wapi?
s06.science.story.02.pages.0.narration: Duma anaweza kukimbia haraka kuliko mnyama yeyote nchi kavu.
s06.science.story.02.pages.1.narration: Konokono anasogea polepole sana hata huwezi kuona anasogea.
s06.science.story.02.pages.2.narration: 'Shindana nami,' asema duma, naye anaondoka kwa kasi.
s06.science.story.02.pages.3.narration: Lakini duma anaweza kukimbia kwa kasi kwa muda mfupi sana tu.
s06.science.story.02.pages.4.narration: Anasimama kupumzika chini ya mti. Konokono anaendelea.
s06.science.story.02.pages.5.narration: Kasi si daima wa kwanza. Polepole na thabiti hufika pia.
s06.science.story.02.parentNote: Polepole si sawa na kutokuwa hodari. Ndilo lengo la mwisho — inafaa kusemwa kwa sauti.
s06.science.story.02.title: Konokono na Duma
s06.social.lesson.01.steps.1.feedback: 'Wimbo wa taifa ni wimbo maalum wa nchi.'
s06.social.lesson.01.steps.1.narration: Gusa noti ya muziki kusikia wimbo wa taifa.
s06.social.lesson.01.steps.2.feedback: Bendera hutumia rangi na umbo kuwakilisha mahali.
s06.social.lesson.01.steps.2.narration: Kila nchi ina bendera yake. Gusa bendera unayoijua.
s06.social.lesson.01.steps.3.narration: Tazama: bendera ni picha ya nchi, na wimbo wa taifa ni wimbo wake.
s06.social.lesson.01.steps.4.narration: Watu husimama wimbo wa taifa unapopigwa. Gusa usimame.
s06.social.lesson.01.steps.5.feedback: Rangi hizo zina maana kwa kila anayeishi huko.
s06.social.lesson.01.steps.5.narration: Gusa rangi zilizo kwenye bendera ya nchi yako.
s06.social.lesson.01.steps.6.narration: Je, wimbo wa taifa ni wimbo au picha? Gusa wimbo.
s06.social.lesson.01.steps.7.narration: Bendera na wimbo wa taifa ni mali ya kila mtu nchini.
s06.social.lesson.01.title: Bendera na wimbo wetu wa taifa
s06.social.lesson.02.parentNote: Tambua na taja uraia mwema maishani.
s06.social.lesson.02.recap.0.prompt: Raia mwema hufanya nini kwa wengine?
s06.social.lesson.02.recap.1.prompt: Kupokezana na kumpa rafiki sehemu kunaitwa…
s06.social.lesson.02.steps.0.feedback: Kusaidia hufanya darasa letu kuwa bora!
s06.social.lesson.02.steps.0.narration: Raia wema husaidia wengine. Gusa kusaidia kubeba vitabu.
s06.social.lesson.02.steps.1.narration: Hushiriki na kufuata sheria. Gusa kushiriki.
s06.social.lesson.02.steps.2.feedback: Kwenye pipa. Barabara ni bora kwa kila mtu!
s06.social.lesson.02.steps.2.narration: Raia wema huweka maeneo safi. Gusa takataka uitupe kwenye pipa.
s06.social.lesson.02.steps.3.feedback: Vitendo vidogo, vinavyofanywa na wengi, hubadilisha jamii nzima.
s06.social.lesson.02.steps.3.narration: Tazama: raia ni mtu anayeishi mahali na kupasaidia.
s06.social.lesson.02.steps.4.feedback: Umesaidia bila kuombwa. Hilo ndilo linalohesabika zaidi.
s06.social.lesson.02.steps.4.narration: Mtu ameangusha vitabu vyake. Gusa umsaidie.
s06.social.lesson.02.steps.5.feedback: Kusubiri ni haki. Haki ndiyo lengo la sheria.
s06.social.lesson.02.steps.5.narration: Sheria huweka kila mtu salama. Gusa usubiri zamu yako.
s06.social.lesson.02.steps.6.narration: Je, kutupa takataka ovyo ni uraia mwema? Gusa hapana.
s06.social.lesson.02.steps.7.narration: Kusaidia, kushirikiana, kufuata sheria za haki.
s06.social.lesson.02.title: Kuwa raia mwema
s06.social.lesson.03.steps.0.narration: Ramani huonyesha vitu kutoka juu, ukiangalia chini. Gusa kitanda kwenye ramani ya chumba.
s06.social.lesson.03.steps.2.narration: Gusa dirisha kwenye ramani ya chumba.
s06.social.lesson.03.steps.3.feedback: Ramani ni dunia kutoka juu, iliyofanywa ndogo.
s06.social.lesson.03.steps.3.narration: Tazama: simama juu ya kiti na uangalie chini. Mwonekano huo ni ramani.
s06.social.lesson.03.steps.4.feedback: Ramani hutumia picha ndogo kwa maeneo halisi.
s06.social.lesson.03.steps.4.narration: Ramani hii inaonyesha shule na barabara. Gusa shule.
s06.social.lesson.03.steps.5.feedback: Umetengeneza njia. Hicho ndicho ramani zinafanya!
s06.social.lesson.03.steps.5.narration: Fuatilia njia kutoka mlangoni hadi kitandani. Gusa njia.
s06.social.lesson.03.steps.6.narration: Je, ramani huonyesha vitu kutoka pembeni au kutoka juu? Gusa juu.
s06.social.lesson.03.steps.7.narration: Ramani hubadilisha mahali kuwa picha unayoweza kuisoma.
s06.social.lesson.03.title: Ramani kutoka juu
s06.social.lesson.04.recap.0.prompt: Mkate ni kitu unachoweza kushika, kwa hivyo ni…
s06.social.lesson.04.recap.1.prompt: Kunyoa nywele ni kazi unayofanyiwa, kwa hivyo ni…
s06.social.lesson.04.steps.0.narration: Mkate ni bidhaa. Kitu tunachoweza kushika. Vuta kwenye 'bidhaa'.
s06.social.lesson.04.steps.1.narration: Kunyoa nywele ni huduma. Kitu tunachofanyiwa. Vuta kwenye 'huduma'.
s06.social.lesson.04.steps.3.feedback: Je, unaweza kukishika, au kinafanywa kwa ajili yako? Huo ndio mtihani.
s06.social.lesson.04.steps.3.narration: Tazama: bidhaa ni vitu, huduma ni kazi zinazofanywa kwa ajili yako.
s06.social.lesson.04.steps.4.feedback: Huduma! Kufundisha ni kazi, si kitu.
s06.social.lesson.04.steps.4.narration: Mwalimu anayefundisha ni huduma. Iburute hadi 'huduma'.
s06.social.lesson.04.steps.5.feedback: Sarafu hununua bidhaa na huduma sawa.
s06.social.lesson.04.steps.5.narration: Fedha hununua vyote viwili. Gusa sarafu.
s06.social.lesson.04.steps.6.narration: Je, kumwona daktari ni bidhaa au huduma? Gusa huduma.
s06.social.lesson.04.steps.7.feedback: Sasa unaweza kupanga kazi au kitu chochote.
s06.social.lesson.04.steps.7.narration: Mkate ni bidhaa unayoishika. Kukatwa nywele ni huduma unayofanyiwa.
s06.social.lesson.04.title: Bidhaa na huduma
s06.social.lesson.05.parentNote: Shiriki chakula, wimbo, au neno kutoka utamaduni wa familia yenu.
s06.social.lesson.05.steps.0.narration: Watoto kote duniani hula vyakula tofauti. Gusa kuchunguza.
s06.social.lesson.05.steps.1.narration: Tunavaa nguo tofauti na kuzungumza lugha tofauti. Zote maalum.
s06.social.lesson.05.steps.2.narration: Watoto kila mahali hucheza. Gusa mchezo wa mpira unaoujua.
s06.social.lesson.05.steps.3.feedback: Kila mtu anahitaji chakula, makazi na familia.
s06.social.lesson.05.steps.3.narration: Tazama: nyumba, chakula na mavazi hutofautiana, lakini mahitaji ni yale yale.
s06.social.lesson.05.steps.4.narration: Nyumba nyingine ni ndefu, nyingine ni za mviringo. Gusa nyumba tofauti na yako.
s06.social.lesson.05.steps.5.feedback: Hujambo husikika tofauti kila mahali, na maana ni ile ile!
s06.social.lesson.05.steps.5.narration: Sema hujambo kwa lugha mpya. Gusa usikie moja.
s06.social.lesson.05.steps.6.feedback: Ndiyo. Mahitaji ni yale yale kila mahali.
s06.social.lesson.05.steps.6.narration: Je, watoto wa nchi nyingine wanahitaji chakula pia? Gusa ndiyo.
s06.social.lesson.05.steps.7.feedback: Hilo ni wazo kubwa, na unalo.
s06.social.lesson.05.steps.7.narration: Njia nyingi za kuishi. Dunia moja.
s06.social.lesson.05.title: Watu kote duniani
s06.social.lesson.06.recap.1.prompt: Vifaa hufanya nini kadri muda unavyopita?
s06.social.lesson.06.steps.0.narration: Zamani, watu waliandika barua kwa mkono. Gusa kalamu ya manyoya.
s06.social.lesson.06.steps.1.feedback: Sasa! Vifaa hubadilika kadri ya wakati.
s06.social.lesson.06.steps.1.narration: Sasa tunaweza kutuma ujumbe kwa simu. Gusa simu.
s06.social.lesson.06.steps.2.narration: Zamani, watu walifua nguo kwa mikono. Gusa njia ya zamani.
s06.social.lesson.06.steps.3.feedback: Watu bado huandika na kufua. Ni jinsi tu iliyobadilika.
s06.social.lesson.06.steps.3.narration: Tazama: vifaa hubadilika, lakini kazi hubaki ile ile.
s06.social.lesson.06.steps.4.narration: Zamani farasi alivuta gari la mkokoteni. Sasa gari huendeshwa. Gusa gari.
s06.social.lesson.06.steps.5.feedback: Historia ipo ndani ya familia yako!
s06.social.lesson.06.steps.5.narration: Muulize mtu mzima walitumia nini kabla ya simu. Gusa simu.
s06.social.lesson.06.steps.6.narration: Kipi ni cha zamani: manyoya ya kuandikia au simu? Gusa manyoya.
s06.social.lesson.06.steps.7.narration: Zamani za kale na sasa — unaweza kulinganisha katika nyakati.
s06.social.lesson.06.title: Zamani na sasa
s06.social.quiz.01.parentNote: Hadithi za familia ni bora kuliko kitabu chochote hapa. Muulize babu au bibi walitumia nini badala yake.
s06.social.quiz.01.questions.0.correctFe: Zamani, watu walitumia farasi na mikokoteni.
s06.social.quiz.01.questions.0.retryFeed: Kipi ni cha zamani zaidi? Jaribu tena!
s06.social.quiz.01.questions.1.correctFe: Unyoya uliochovywa kwenye wino. Kazi ya polepole!
s06.social.quiz.01.questions.1.retryFeed: Simu ni mpya. Nini kilikuwepo kabla? Jaribu tena!
s06.social.quiz.01.questions.2.correctFe: Watu bado huandika na kusafiri. Ni jinsi tu iliyobadilika.
s06.social.quiz.01.questions.2.prompt: Vifaa hubadilika kwa muda. Nini hubaki vile vile?
s06.social.quiz.01.questions.2.retryFeed: Je, watu bado hutuma ujumbe leo? Jaribu tena!
s06.social.quiz.01.questions.3.correctFe: Friji. Manyoya ya kuandikia ni ya zamani, si sasa.
s06.social.quiz.01.questions.3.retryFeed: Kipi kipo jikoni kwako? Jaribu tena!
s06.social.quiz.01.title: Zamani na Sasa
s06.social.quiz.02.parentNote: Litamke kwa sauti wanapofanya — 'umeitupa kwenye pipa bila kuombwa' hufundisha zaidi kuliko jaribio hili.
s06.social.quiz.02.questions.0.retryFeed: Chaguo lipi ni jema kwa wengine? Jaribu tena!
s06.social.quiz.02.questions.1.correctFe: Sheria ndiyo njia ya kundi kubaki na haki kwa kila mtu.
s06.social.quiz.02.questions.1.options.0: Kuweka kila mtu salama na kwa haki
s06.social.quiz.02.questions.1.retryFeed: Nini kingetokea bila sheria kabisa? Jaribu tena!
s06.social.quiz.02.questions.2.correctFe: Kusaidia bila kuombwa ndiko kunakohesabika zaidi.
s06.social.quiz.02.questions.2.prompt: Mtu ameangusha vitabu vyake ukumbini. Unafanya nini?
s06.social.quiz.02.questions.3.correctFe: Vitendo vidogo, vinavyofanywa na wengi, hubadilisha mahali pote.
s06.social.quiz.02.questions.3.prompt: Bustani imejaa takataka. Nini kinasaidia zaidi?
s06.social.quiz.02.questions.3.retryFeed: Njia ipi hukamilisha haraka zaidi? Jaribu tena!
s06.social.quiz.02.title: Raia Mwema
s06.social.quiz.03.parentNote: Chora nyumba yenu kutoka juu pamoja. Kukosea mtazamo mara moja hufundisha zaidi kuliko kupata kwa bahati.
s06.social.quiz.03.questions.0.retryFeed: Ramani huonyesha vitu vilipo. Jaribu tena!
s06.social.quiz.03.questions.1.prompt: Ramani huonyesha vitu kutoka mtazamo upi?
s06.social.quiz.03.questions.1.retryFeed: Fikiria umesimama juu ya kiti. Jaribu tena!
s06.social.quiz.03.questions.2.correctFe: Hubadilisha mahali kuwa kitu unachoweza kusoma.
s06.social.quiz.03.questions.2.retryFeed: Kwa nini msafiri angebeba moja? Jaribu tena!
s06.social.quiz.03.questions.3.correctFe: Ukiangalia chini, kitanda ni mstatili. Ramani huchora unachoona.
s06.social.quiz.03.questions.3.options.0: Hilo ndilo umbo lake kutoka juu
s06.social.quiz.03.questions.3.prompt: Kwenye ramani ya chumba, kitanda kinaonekana kama mstatili mdogo. Kwa nini?
s06.social.quiz.03.title: Tafuta Ramani
s06.social.quiz.04.parentNote: Mtihani ni rahisi: unaweza kukibeba nyumbani? Jaribuni kwenye duka mtakalotembelea pamoja.
s06.social.quiz.04.questions.0.retryFeed: Kipi unaweza kukibeba nyumbani? Jaribu tena!
s06.social.quiz.04.questions.1.correctFe: Huduma. Kazi inayofanywa kwa ajili yako, hakuna cha kubeba.
s06.social.quiz.04.questions.1.retryFeed: Kipi ni kazi anayofanya mtu? Jaribu tena!
s06.social.quiz.04.questions.2.correctFe: Huduma. Kufundisha ni kazi, si kitu.
s06.social.quiz.04.questions.2.retryFeed: Unaweza kuweka somo mfukoni? Jaribu tena!
s06.social.quiz.04.questions.3.correctFe: Zote. Unalipia kukatwa nywele na mkate sawa.
s06.social.quiz.04.title: Bidhaa na Huduma
s06.social.story.01.pages.0.narration: Bustani ya darasa imejaa takataka. Hakuna anayejua nani aliitupa.
s06.social.story.01.pages.1.narration: 'Si uchafu wetu,' asema mtoto mmoja. Wengine wanaangalia chini.
s06.social.story.01.pages.2.narration: 'Lakini ni bustani yetu,' asema mwingine. Hilo linamaliza shauri.
s06.social.story.01.pages.3.narration: Kwa pamoja wanaokota yote. Inachukua muda mfupi kuliko walivyohofia.
s06.social.story.01.pages.4.narration: Kisha wanapanda ua mahali rundo baya zaidi lilipokuwa.
s06.social.story.01.pages.5.narration: Sasa bustani ni safi. Raia wema hurekebisha kile wanachoshiriki.
s06.social.story.01.parentNote: Uliza wangefanya nini kuhusu uchafu ambao hakuna aliyeutengeneza kwa makusudi. Swali hilo ndilo somo zima.
s06.social.story.01.title: Darasa Letu Linasaidia
s06.social.story.02.pages.0.narration: Juma anaenda nyumbani kwa bibi. Mama anamchorea ramani.
s06.social.story.02.pages.1.narration: Ramani inaangalia barabara kutoka juu, kama ndege.
s06.social.story.02.pages.2.narration: Pita shule, kisha kushoto kwenye mti mkubwa.
s06.social.story.02.pages.3.narration: Kwenye mti, Juma anasimama. Kuna njia mbili, si moja.
s06.social.story.02.pages.4.narration: Anaangalia tena. Ramani inaonyesha mto kando ya njia ya kulia.
s06.social.story.02.pages.5.narration: Anasikia maji na anachukua njia hiyo. Bibi anasubiri.
s06.social.story.02.parentNote: Choreni njia ya kwenda mahali halisi baadaye. Ramani waliyoitengeneza ndiyo wanayoweza kuisoma.
s06.social.story.02.title: Ramani ya Kwenda kwa Bibi
s06.tech.lesson.01.recap.0.prompt: Ni kizuizi kipi husogeza roboti mbele?
s06.tech.lesson.01.recap.1.prompt: Unapaswa kubonyeza nini ili kuendesha vizuizi vyako?
s06.tech.lesson.01.steps.0.narration: Roboti lazima afike nyota. Vuta kizuizi cha mbele.
s06.tech.lesson.01.steps.1.feedback: Roboti anasonga na kufika nyota! 'Umeiandika hiyo kwa msimbo!' ⭐
s06.tech.lesson.01.steps.1.narration: Ongeza geuka kushoto, kisha mbele. Bonyeza cheza.
s06.tech.lesson.01.steps.2.narration: Nyota imehama. Buruta mbele, mbele, geuka kulia.
s06.tech.lesson.01.steps.3.feedback: Ndiyo maana mpangilio ni muhimu sana.
s06.tech.lesson.01.steps.3.narration: Tazama: kompyuta hufanya ulichoandika, si ulichokusudia.
s06.tech.lesson.01.steps.4.feedback: Vipande vichache, nyota ile ile. Msimbo safi!
s06.tech.lesson.01.steps.4.narration: Njia mbili zinafika kwenye nyota. Buruta fupi zaidi.
s06.tech.lesson.01.steps.5.feedback: Kila kipande, kwa mpangilio wako. Umeandika msimbo!
s06.tech.lesson.01.steps.5.narration: Bonyeza cheza na utazame programu yako ikiendeshwa.
s06.tech.lesson.01.steps.6.narration: Roboti ikigeuka upande usio sahihi, roboti ndiyo imekosea au msimbo? Gusa msimbo.
s06.tech.lesson.01.steps.7.narration: Programu ni orodha ya hatua kwa mpangilio.
s06.tech.lesson.01.title: Ongoza roboti
s06.tech.lesson.02.steps.0.narration: Tafuta maumbo ya nyekundu na ya mviringo. Vuta kwenye sanduku.
s06.tech.lesson.02.steps.1.narration: Kanuni mbili kwa wakati mmoja. Kufikiri vizuri!
s06.tech.lesson.02.steps.2.feedback: Buluu na mraba. Sheria zote mbili!
s06.tech.lesson.02.steps.2.narration: Sasa tafuta maumbo yaliyo ya buluu na ya mraba. Yaburute.
s06.tech.lesson.02.steps.3.narration: Tazama: kwa sheria mbili, kitu lazima kipite zote mbili, si moja tu.
s06.tech.lesson.02.steps.4.narration: Kubwa na ya njano. Buruta hizo tu.
s06.tech.lesson.02.steps.5.feedback: Hapana — mwekundu ndiyo, mviringo hapana. Lazima ipite zote.
s06.tech.lesson.02.steps.5.narration: Mraba mwekundu: je, unapita 'mwekundu na wa mviringo'? Gusa hapana.
s06.tech.lesson.02.steps.6.feedback: Kupanga kwa sheria ndivyo kompyuta hutafuta vitu!
s06.tech.lesson.02.steps.6.narration: Panga vitu vyako vya kuchezea kwa sheria mbili kisha gusa ukimaliza.
s06.tech.lesson.02.steps.7.feedback: Kompyuta hupanga kwa sheria mchana kutwa.
s06.tech.lesson.02.steps.7.narration: Sheria mbili kwa pamoja. Hiyo ni mantiki.
s06.tech.lesson.02.title: Panga kwa kanuni mbili
s06.tech.lesson.03.recap.0.prompt: Hatua zilizo katika mpangilio sahihi huunda…
s06.tech.lesson.03.steps.0.narration: Kupiga mswaki: lowanisha mswaki, weka dawa, piga mswaki, suuza. Vipange kwa mpangilio.
s06.tech.lesson.03.steps.2.narration: Kutengeneza tosti: chukua mkate, choma, paka, kula. Buruta kwa mpangilio.
s06.tech.lesson.03.steps.3.narration: Tazama: badilisha hatua mbili na kila kitu kinaharibika.
s06.tech.lesson.03.steps.4.narration: Kuvaa: soksi kabla ya viatu. Buruta kwa mpangilio.
s06.tech.lesson.03.steps.5.feedback: Umeirekebisha. Hivyo ndivyo waandishi wa misimbo hufanya!
s06.tech.lesson.03.steps.5.narration: Mtu ameweka 'suuza' kabla ya 'piga mswaki'. Gusa kosa.
s06.tech.lesson.03.steps.6.narration: Je, hatua zile zile kwa mpangilio tofauti hutoa matokeo yale yale? Gusa hapana.
s06.tech.lesson.03.steps.7.narration: Hatua kwa mpangilio sahihi hufanya algoriti.
s06.tech.lesson.03.title: Hatua kwa mpangilio
s06.tech.lesson.04.recap.0.prompt: Katika mpangilio nyekundu, nyekundu, ___, nyekundu, nyekundu, ___ ni kipi kinajaza nafasi?
s06.tech.lesson.04.steps.0.narration: Nyekundu, nyekundu, buluu, nyekundu, nyekundu, buluu... gusa kinachofuata.
s06.tech.lesson.04.steps.1.narration: Mifumo hujirudia. Nini kinakuja baada ya hapo?
s06.tech.lesson.04.steps.2.narration: Duara, mraba, duara, mraba... gusa kinachofuata.
s06.tech.lesson.04.steps.3.narration: Tazama: tafuta sehemu ya mchoro inayojirudia, kisha isema tena.
s06.tech.lesson.04.steps.4.feedback: Ngoma! Michoro hufanya kazi katika sauti pia.
s06.tech.lesson.04.steps.4.narration: Sikiliza: ngoma, ngoma, kengele, ngoma, ngoma, kengele... gusa kinachofuata.
s06.tech.lesson.04.steps.5.narration: Tengeneza mchoro wako kwa rangi mbili kisha gusa ukimaliza.
s06.tech.lesson.04.steps.6.narration: Katika nyekundu, buluu, buluu, nyekundu, buluu, buluu — gusa sehemu inayojirudia.
s06.tech.lesson.04.steps.7.narration: Michoro hujirudia, na unaweza kupata kinachojirudia daima.
s06.tech.lesson.04.title: Tambua mfumo
s06.tech.lesson.05.recap.0.prompt: Ni sehemu ipi ya kompyuta kibao unayoona na kugusa?
s06.tech.lesson.05.recap.1.prompt: Ni sehemu ipi huiwasha na kuizima?
s06.tech.lesson.05.steps.1.feedback: Kitufe. Huwasha na kuzima kompyuta kibao.
s06.tech.lesson.05.steps.1.narration: Sehemu ipi huwasha na kuzima kompyuta kibao?
s06.tech.lesson.05.steps.2.narration: Kipaza sauti cha kompyuta kibao hutuwezesha kusikia. Gusa kipaza sauti.
s06.tech.lesson.05.steps.3.narration: Tazama: kila sehemu ina kazi moja — kuonyesha, kusikia, kuwasha, kuchaji.
s06.tech.lesson.05.steps.4.feedback: Jicho dogo kwenye kompyuta yako kibao!
s06.tech.lesson.05.steps.4.narration: Kamera ya kompyuta kibao hupiga picha. Gusa kamera.
s06.tech.lesson.05.steps.5.feedback: Bila chaji, hakuna kompyuta kibao. Hiyo ndiyo kazi yake.
s06.tech.lesson.05.steps.6.narration: SKRINI huonyesha picha; kitufe huwasha tu kompyuta kibao. Gusa skrini.
s06.tech.lesson.05.steps.7.narration: Unaweza kutaja sehemu za kompyuta yako kibao.
s06.tech.lesson.05.title: Sehemu za kibao-tarakilishi
s06.tech.lesson.06.parentNote: Kubaliana kanuni: daima uliza kabla ya kushiriki chochote mtandaoni.
s06.tech.lesson.06.recap.0.prompt: Skrini ikikuuliza jina au picha yako, unapaswa…
s06.tech.lesson.06.steps.0.narration: Skrini ikiomba jina lako au picha, simama. Gusa kumtafuta mtu mzima.
s06.tech.lesson.06.steps.1.narration: Watu wazima hutusaidia kuwa salama mtandaoni.
s06.tech.lesson.06.steps.2.feedback: Simama kwanza, daima. Mtu mzima huamua.
s06.tech.lesson.06.steps.2.narration: Mchezo kwenye kompyuta kibao unaomba picha yako. Gusa usimame na uulize.
s06.tech.lesson.06.steps.3.feedback: Siri maana yake ni yako, si ya skrini.
s06.tech.lesson.06.steps.3.narration: Tazama: jina lako, picha yako na nyumba yako haviingii kwenye kompyuta kamwe.
s06.tech.lesson.06.steps.4.feedback: Zawadi kwenye skrini mara nyingi ni hila.
s06.tech.lesson.06.steps.4.narration: Dirisha linasema umeshinda zawadi. Gusa ulifunge na umwambie mtu.
s06.tech.lesson.06.steps.5.feedback: Huna haja ya kumjibu mtu usiyemjua kamwe.
s06.tech.lesson.06.steps.5.narration: Mtu usiyemjua anatuma ujumbe. Gusa umwambie mtu mzima.
s06.tech.lesson.06.steps.6.feedback: Hapana. Hiyo ni siri. Uliza kwanza.
s06.tech.lesson.06.steps.6.narration: Je, uandike anwani ya nyumbani kwenye kompyuta kibao? Gusa hapana.
s06.tech.lesson.06.steps.7.feedback: Tabia hiyo moja hukuweka salama mtandaoni.
s06.tech.lesson.06.steps.7.narration: Simama, kisha muulize mtu mzima. Kila wakati.
s06.tech.lesson.06.title: Simama na uulize
