s06.tech.quiz.04.questions.2.prompt: Kipi ni kikali zaidi: 'chekundu na cha mviringo' au 'chekundu au cha mviringo'?
s06.tech.quiz.04.questions.2.retryFeedba: Kipi kinaruhusu vitu vingi zaidi kupita? Jaribu tena!
s06.tech.quiz.04.questions.3.correctFeed: Kupanga ndiyo njia ya kompyuta kupata kitu kimoja kati ya mamilioni.
s06.tech.quiz.04.questions.3.prompt: Kwa nini kompyuta hupanga kwa sheria?
s06.tech.quiz.04.questions.3.retryFeedba: Fikiria kupata kitabu kimoja katika maktaba kubwa. Jaribu tena!
s06.tech.quiz.04.title: Panga kwa Sheria Mbili
s06.tech.story.01.pages.0.narration: Vitu vya kuchezea vya Robo vimechanganyika katika rundo moja kubwa.
s06.tech.story.01.pages.1.narration: 'Sheria moja kwa wakati,' asema Robo. 'Kwanza, vipande na vipande.'
s06.tech.story.01.pages.2.narration: Kisha magari na magari. Rundo linapungua.
s06.tech.story.01.pages.3.narration: Lakini vipande vyekundu na vya buluu bado vimechanganyika.
s06.tech.story.01.pages.4.narration: Hivyo Robo anapanga tena — kwa umbo NA kwa rangi. Sheria mbili.
s06.tech.story.01.pages.5.narration: Kila kitu safi. 'Sheria mbili zimepata kila kitu,' asema Robo. 'Mantiki nzuri!'
s06.tech.story.01.parentNote: Kupanga kwa sheria moja ni rahisi; kwa mbili ndiyo ujuzi halisi. Kufagia nyumbani ni kitendawili kile kile.
s06.tech.story.01.title: Robo Anapanga Vitu vya Kuchezea
s06.tech.story.02.pages.0.narration: Nia anajenga roboti. Inafanya hasa inavyoambiwa. Hasa.
s06.tech.story.02.pages.1.narration: 'Vaa viatu vyako, kisha soksi zako,' asema Nia.
s06.tech.story.02.pages.2.narration: Roboti inavaa soksi juu ya viatu. Nia anacheka.
s06.tech.story.02.pages.4.narration: Anabadilisha hatua hizo mbili na kuendesha programu tena.
s06.tech.story.02.pages.5.narration: Soksi, kisha viatu. Kamili. Programu ni nzuri kadiri ya mpangilio wake.
s06.tech.story.02.parentNote: Jaribuni kwa vitendo: toa maagizo kamili ya kutengeneza sandwichi na yafuate hasa. Kicheko ndicho somo.
s06.tech.story.02.title: Roboti Aliyefuata Maagizo Hasa
s07.health.lesson.01.recap.0.prompt: Tufaha ni la kundi lipi la chakula?
s07.health.lesson.01.steps.0.narration: Panga tofaa kwenye kundi la matunda.
s07.health.lesson.01.steps.1.feedback: Sugua-sugua kwa sekunde 20. 'Safi na mwenye afya!'
s07.health.lesson.01.steps.1.narration: Gusa kunawa mikono kabla ya kula.
s07.health.lesson.01.steps.2.feedback: Nafaka hutupa nguvu za kukimbia na kucheza.
s07.health.lesson.01.steps.2.narration: Sasa panga mkate katika kundi la nafaka.
s07.health.lesson.01.steps.3.feedback: Makundi tofauti hufanya kazi tofauti mwilini mwako.
s07.health.lesson.01.steps.3.narration: Tazama: sahani nzuri ina chakula kutoka makundi kadhaa, si moja tu.
s07.health.lesson.01.steps.4.feedback: Makundi matatu kwenye sahani moja. Hicho ni chakula bora!
s07.health.lesson.01.steps.4.narration: Jenga sahani yenye tunda, nafaka na kitu kutoka kundi la maziwa.
s07.health.lesson.01.steps.5.feedback: Mikono safi huzuia vijidudu kufika kwenye chakula chako.
s07.health.lesson.01.steps.5.narration: Kabla ya kugusa chakula, mikono kwanza. Gusa maji uoshe.
s07.health.lesson.01.steps.6.narration: Je, tufaha ni tunda au nafaka? Gusa kikapu cha matunda.
s07.health.lesson.01.steps.7.narration: Makundi ya chakula sahanini, mikono safi mezani.
s07.health.lesson.01.title: Makundi ya vyakula na usafi
s07.health.lesson.02.parentNote: Nawa mikono pamoja kabla ya milo na baada ya choo.
s07.health.lesson.02.recap.0.prompt: Unapaswa kusugua mikono kwa muda gani?
s07.health.lesson.02.steps.0.feedback: Mikono inayoonekana safi inaweza kuwa navyo.
s07.health.lesson.02.steps.0.narration: Vijidudu ni viumbe hai vidogo sana visivyoonekana. Vinaweza kukaa mikononi yako.
s07.health.lesson.02.steps.1.feedback: Kabla ya kula. Ndio wakati mikono inakaribia mdomo wako.
s07.health.lesson.02.steps.1.narration: Vijidudu huingia mwilini kupitia mdomo, kwa hiyo wakati mmoja ni muhimu zaidi.
s07.health.lesson.02.steps.2.narration: Hatua tatu: tia maji mikononi, paka sabuni, kisha sugua.
s07.health.lesson.02.steps.3.feedback: Hesabu tano za polepole. Endelea muda huo kila wakati.
s07.health.lesson.02.steps.3.narration: Kusugua huchukua muda zaidi kuliko unavyofikiri. Gusa kiputo kwa kila hesabu ya polepole.
s07.health.lesson.02.steps.4.narration: Usisahau katikati ya vidole, na chini ya kucha.
s07.health.lesson.02.steps.5.feedback: Sabuni na maji pamoja. Hiyo ndiyo jozi inayosafisha.
s07.health.lesson.02.steps.5.narration: Maji peke yake yanasukuma vijidudu tu. Sabuni inaviondoa.
s07.health.lesson.02.steps.6.feedback: Nawa mikono. Kabla ya kugusa chakula au uso wako.
s07.health.lesson.02.steps.6.narration: Umekuwa unacheza nje kwenye udongo. Sasa nini?
s07.health.lesson.02.steps.7.narration: Hatua ya mwisho: kausha kwa kitambaa safi. Mikono yenye maji inachukua vijidudu tena.
s07.health.lesson.02.steps.8.feedback: Maji, sabuni, sugua, suuza, kausha. Kila wakati.
s07.health.lesson.02.title: Nawa mikono yako
s07.health.lesson.03.parentNote: Tengenezeni sahani yenye rangi pamoja wakati wa mlo.
s07.health.lesson.03.recap.0.prompt: Ni vyakula vipi hutusaidia kukua kila siku?
s07.health.lesson.03.steps.0.narration: Matunda na mboga hutusaidia kukua. Vuta tofaa kwenye sahani.
s07.health.lesson.03.steps.1.narration: Peremende ni vyakula vya 'mara kwa mara'. Vyakula vyenye afya ni vya 'kila siku'.
s07.health.lesson.03.steps.2.feedback: Mboga! Rangi sahanini ni ishara nzuri.
s07.health.lesson.03.steps.2.narration: Buruta karoti hadi sahanini. Mboga huhesabika pia.
s07.health.lesson.03.steps.3.feedback: Hakuna kilichokatazwa. Ni suala la mara ngapi.
s07.health.lesson.03.steps.3.narration: Tazama: vyakula vya 'kila siku' na vya 'mara chache' vyote vinaruhusiwa.
s07.health.lesson.03.steps.4.feedback: Sahihi — hufurahiwa mara chache, si kila siku.
s07.health.lesson.03.steps.4.narration: Keki kwenye sherehe ni chakula cha 'mara chache'. Iburute hadi 'mara chache'.
s07.health.lesson.03.steps.5.feedback: Maji kila siku. Mwili wako ni maji kwa kiasi kikubwa!
s07.health.lesson.03.steps.5.narration: Maji ndicho kinywaji cha kila siku. Gusa maji.
s07.health.lesson.03.steps.6.feedback: Tufaha. Biskuti ni chakula cha mara chache.
s07.health.lesson.03.steps.6.narration: Kipi ni chakula cha kila siku: tufaha au biskuti? Gusa tufaha.
s07.health.lesson.03.steps.7.feedback: Sasa unaweza kupanga sahani yako mwenyewe.
s07.health.lesson.03.steps.7.narration: Kula rangi zote za upinde wa mvua, siku nyingi.
s07.health.lesson.03.title: Vyakula vyenye afya
s07.health.lesson.04.recap.0.prompt: Kukimbia na kuruka hufanya mioyo yetu kuwa…
s07.health.lesson.04.steps.0.narration: Kukimbia na kuruka hufanya mioyo yetu kuwa imara. Gusa kuruka!
s07.health.lesson.04.steps.1.narration: Kusogea kila siku hutuweka na afya na furaha.
s07.health.lesson.04.steps.2.feedback: Mapigo ya haraka. Moyo wako ni msuli unaozidi kuwa imara!
s07.health.lesson.04.steps.2.narration: Moyo wako hupiga kwa kasi unapokimbia. Gusa moyo.
s07.health.lesson.04.steps.3.feedback: Huo ni mwili wako wote ukifanya kazi pamoja.
s07.health.lesson.04.steps.3.narration: Tazama: kusogea hukupasha joto, na mapafu yako huvuta hewa zaidi.
s07.health.lesson.04.steps.4.narration: Kuendesha baiskeli nako ni kusogea. Gusa baiskeli.
s07.health.lesson.04.steps.5.feedback: Kunywa. Kusogea hutumia maji na nguvu pia.
s07.health.lesson.04.steps.5.narration: Baada ya kusogea, mwili wako unahitaji maji. Gusa kikombe.
s07.health.lesson.04.steps.6.narration: Je, moyo hupiga kwa kasi ukikimbia au ukikaa? Gusa anayekimbia.
s07.health.lesson.04.steps.7.feedback: Moyo imara hujengwa siku baada ya siku.
s07.health.lesson.04.steps.7.narration: Kila siku, sogea vya kutosha kuhisi moyo wako.
s07.health.lesson.04.title: Sogeza mwili wako
s07.health.lesson.05.parentNote: Dumisha ratiba tulivu na ya kawaida ya kulala.
s07.health.lesson.05.recap.0.prompt: Usingizi husaidia mwili na ubongo kufanya nini?
s07.health.lesson.05.steps.0.narration: Usingizi husaidia mwili na ubongo wetu kupumzika na kukua. Gusa kupunguza taa.
s07.health.lesson.05.steps.1.narration: Wakati tulivu wa kulala hutusaidia kulala vizuri.
s07.health.lesson.05.steps.2.feedback: Mwanga hafifu huuambia mwili wako kuwa usiku umefika.
s07.health.lesson.05.steps.2.narration: Chumba tulivu husaidia usingizi kuja. Gusa taa uipunguze.
s07.health.lesson.05.steps.3.feedback: Usingizi si muda uliopotea. Ndipo kujifunza hukaa.
s07.health.lesson.05.steps.3.narration: Tazama: unapolala, ubongo wako hupanga uliyojifunza leo.
s07.health.lesson.05.steps.4.narration: Kitabu kabla ya kulala ni tulivu kuliko skrini yenye mwanga mkali. Gusa kitabu.
s07.health.lesson.05.steps.5.feedback: Mpangilio ule ule kila usiku ndio huifanya iwe rahisi.
s07.health.lesson.05.steps.5.narration: Meno husafishwa kabla ya kulala, kila usiku. Gusa mswaki.
s07.health.lesson.05.steps.6.feedback: Kitabu. Mwanga mkali huufanya ubongo wako uendelee kuwa macho.
s07.health.lesson.05.steps.6.narration: Kipi hukusaidia kulala: kitabu tulivu au skrini yenye mwanga? Gusa kitabu.
s07.health.lesson.05.steps.7.feedback: Ratiba ya kulala ni zawadi kwa wewe wa kesho.
s07.health.lesson.05.steps.7.narration: Hatua zile zile, wakati ule ule, kila usiku.
s07.health.lesson.05.title: Usingizi mzuri
s07.health.lesson.06.parentNote: Fanya kofia ngumu na mikanda ya kiti kuwa tabia isiyo na ubaguzi.
s07.health.lesson.06.recap.1.prompt: Unapaswa kufanya nini ndani ya gari?
s07.health.lesson.06.steps.0.narration: Vaa kofia ngumu unapoendesha baiskeli. Gusa kuivaa.
s07.health.lesson.06.steps.1.narration: Funga mkanda wako wa kiti garini. Gusa kufunga.
s07.health.lesson.06.steps.2.feedback: Pande zote mbili, kila mara. Hata kwenye barabara tulivu.
s07.health.lesson.06.steps.2.narration: Angalia pande zote mbili kabla ya kuvuka. Gusa barabara ikiwa wazi.
s07.health.lesson.06.steps.3.feedback: Mwili wako huendelea kusogea baiskeli inaposimama. Ndiyo sababu.
s07.health.lesson.06.steps.3.narration: Tazama: kofia ngumu na mkanda hufanya kazi moja — hukushikilia.
s07.health.lesson.06.steps.4.feedback: Huendi popote na mtu usiyemjua kamwe. Mwambie unayemwamini.
s07.health.lesson.06.steps.4.narration: Mtu usiyemjua anakupa lifti. Gusa umtafute mtu mzima.
s07.health.lesson.06.steps.5.narration: Ukipotea, kaa mahali pamoja na umtafute msaidizi. Gusa duka.
s07.health.lesson.06.steps.6.feedback: Hapana — kila safari. Kuanguka hakusubiri safari ndefu.
s07.health.lesson.06.steps.6.narration: Je, unavaa kofia ngumu kwenye safari ndefu tu? Gusa hapana.
s07.health.lesson.06.steps.7.feedback: Usalama ni tabia, si sheria unayoikumbuka.
s07.health.lesson.06.steps.7.narration: Kofia ngumu imevaliwa, mkanda umefungwa, pande zote zimeangaliwa.
s07.health.lesson.06.title: Salama salimini
s07.health.quiz.01.parentNote: Tabia inayofaa kujengwa ni kukuambia, si kuhukumu hali peke yao. Hakikisha wanajua hawatapata shida kwa kuuliza.

s07.health.quiz.01.questions.0.prompt: Mgeni mtandaoni anaomba anwani ya nyumbani kwako. Unafanya nini?
s07.health.quiz.01.questions.0.retryFeed: Usishiriki taarifa binafsi mtandaoni. Mwambie mtu mzima. Jaribu tena!
s07.health.quiz.01.questions.1.correctFe: Kofia ngumu, kila safari. Si ndefu tu.
s07.health.quiz.01.questions.1.prompt: Unaendesha baiskeli yako. Nini huvaliwa kwanza?
s07.health.quiz.01.questions.1.retryFeed: Nini hukinga kichwa chako ukianguka? Jaribu tena!
s07.health.quiz.01.questions.2.prompt: Umepotea sokoni penye watu wengi. Jambo salama zaidi ni lipi?
s07.health.quiz.01.questions.2.retryFeed: Mkisogea wote wawili, mnaendelea kukosana. Jaribu tena!

s07.health.quiz.01.questions.3.prompt: Kuvuka barabara tulivu — bado unaangalia pande zote mbili?
s07.health.quiz.01.questions.3.retryFeed: Gari linaweza kuja wakati wowote. Jaribu tena!
s07.health.quiz.01.title: Salama au Si Salama?

s07.health.quiz.02.questions.0.correctFe: Kabla ya kula, na baada ya choo.
s07.health.quiz.02.questions.0.retryFeed: Mikono safi kabla ya chakula. Jaribu tena!
s07.health.quiz.02.questions.1.correctFe: Takriban sekunde 20 — muda wa kutosha kusugua vizuri.
s07.health.quiz.02.questions.1.retryFeed: Kunyunyiza haraka hakuondoi vijidudu. Jaribu tena!
s07.health.quiz.02.questions.2.correctFe: Sabuni. Huinua vijidudu ili maji viviondoe.
s07.health.quiz.02.questions.2.retryFeed: Maji peke yake huteleza juu yake tu. Jaribu tena!
s07.health.quiz.02.questions.3.correctFe: Kabla. Chochote kilicho mikononi huenda kwenye chakula.
s07.health.quiz.02.questions.3.prompt: Umecheza nje na mbwa. Unawe kabla au baada ya kitafunio chako?
s07.health.quiz.02.questions.3.retryFeed: Fikiria mikono yako inagusa chakula na nini. Jaribu tena!
s07.health.quiz.02.title: Lini Kunawa
s07.health.quiz.03.parentNote: Hakuna chakula kilichokatazwa hapa, na hilo ni muhimu — 'mara chache' hufanya vitamu viwe vya kawaida badala ya kukatazwa.
s07.health.quiz.03.questions.0.correctFe: Vipande vya tufaha ni kitafunio bora.
s07.health.quiz.03.questions.0.prompt: Kipi ni kitafunio bora cha kila siku?
s07.health.quiz.03.questions.1.correctFe: Mara chache, si kamwe. Hufurahiwa kisha kuendelea.
s07.health.quiz.03.questions.1.prompt: Keki kwenye sherehe ya kuzaliwa ni...
s07.health.quiz.03.questions.1.retryFeed: Hakuna kilichokatazwa — ni suala la mara ngapi. Jaribu tena!
s07.health.quiz.03.questions.2.correctFe: Maji. Mwili wako ni maji kwa kiasi kikubwa na unahitaji kuongezwa.
s07.health.quiz.03.questions.2.prompt: Kinywaji bora cha kila siku ni kipi?
s07.health.quiz.03.questions.2.retryFeed: Ni kipi mwili wako unahitaji kweli? Jaribu tena!
s07.health.quiz.03.questions.3.correctFe: Makundi mengine. Kundi moja haliwezi kufanya kila kazi.
s07.health.quiz.03.questions.3.prompt: Sahani yenye mkate tu imekosa nini?
s07.health.quiz.03.questions.3.retryFeed: Fikiria matunda, mboga na maziwa. Jaribu tena!
s07.health.quiz.03.title: Kitafunio Bora

s07.health.quiz.04.questions.0.correctFe: Hupanga na kuhifadhi siku. Usingizi ndipo kujifunza hukaa.
s07.health.quiz.04.questions.0.retryFeed: Usingizi ni kazi, si bure. Jaribu tena!

s07.health.quiz.04.questions.1.retryFeed: Mwanga mkali huufanya ubongo uendelee kuwa macho. Jaribu tena!
s07.health.quiz.04.questions.2.correctFe: Kukimbia. Moyo wako ni msuli, na huzidi kuwa imara.
s07.health.quiz.04.questions.2.prompt: Moyo wako hupiga kwa kasi unapo...
s07.health.quiz.04.questions.2.retryFeed: Ni lini kifua chako hudunda? Jaribu tena!
s07.health.quiz.04.questions.3.correctFe: Vyote. Kimoja hukujenga, kingine hukurudisha pamoja.
s07.health.quiz.04.questions.3.retryFeed: Ungeweza kukimbia mchana kutwa bila kulala? Jaribu tena!
s07.health.quiz.04.title: Pumzika na Sogea
s07.health.story.01.pages.0.narration: Zoe anaamka na kupiga mswaki, juu na chini.
s07.health.story.01.pages.1.narration: Kifungua kinywa ni tunda na mkate — makundi mawili sahanini.
s07.health.story.01.pages.2.narration: Anakimbia na kucheza nje hadi moyo wake unadunda.
s07.health.story.01.pages.3.narration: Kabla ya chakula cha mchana anaosha mikono. Sekunde ishirini, kwa sabuni.
s07.health.story.01.pages.4.narration: Usiku taa inapungua na anasoma kitabu kimoja kwa utulivu.
s07.health.story.01.pages.5.narration: Analala, na ubongo wake unapanga yote aliyojifunza. Siku ya afya!
s07.health.story.01.parentNote: Zungumzeni tabia za siku ya afya za mtoto wako. Ni zipi za Zoe anazofanya tayari bila kuombwa?
s07.health.story.01.title: Siku ya Afya na Zoe
s07.health.story.02.pages.0.narration: Tomas anaenda dukani kwa baiskeli yake. Ni karibu sana.
s07.health.story.02.pages.1.narration: 'Ni barabara mbili tu,' asema. 'Sihitaji kofia ngumu.'
s07.health.story.02.pages.2.narration: Dada yake anauliza: 'Je, kuanguka kunajua unaenda mbali kiasi gani?'
s07.health.story.02.pages.4.narration: Anafunga kofia ngumu. Inachukua sekunde nne.
s07.health.story.02.pages.5.narration: Hakuna kinachotokea njiani. Hilo ndilo lengo hasa.
s07.health.story.02.parentNote: Hakuna anayeumia katika hadithi hii, kwa makusudi. Lengo ni tabia, si kutisha.
s07.health.story.02.title: Sheria ya Kofia Ngumu
s07.math.lesson.01.steps.3.feedback: Kutengeneza kumi kwanza ni haraka kuliko kuhesabu kila ruka.
s07.math.lesson.01.steps.3.narration: Tazama njia fupi: 9 + 6 ni 10 + 5, kwa sababu moja huvuka.
s07.math.lesson.01.steps.4.narration: Tumia njia fupi: 8 + 7. Tengeneza kumi kwanza.
s07.math.lesson.01.steps.5.narration: Sasa kurudi nyuma: 16 - 7. Ruka nyuma kutoka 16.
s07.math.lesson.01.steps.6.feedback: 7! Mstari wa namba hufanya kazi kwa fedha pia.
s07.math.lesson.01.steps.6.narration: Una sarafu 12 na unatumia 5. Zimebaki ngapi?
s07.math.lesson.01.steps.7.feedback: Mstari mmoja wa namba, matendo yote mawili.
s07.math.lesson.01.title: Jumlisha na toa hadi 20
s07.math.lesson.02.steps.0.narration: Hesabu kubwa zinaweza kuwa rahisi. Tazama hii: 8 + 7.
s07.math.lesson.02.steps.1.narration: Kumi ni rafiki yetu. Ni rahisi kujumlisha na kumi.
s07.math.lesson.02.steps.2.narration: Nane iko karibu na kumi. Inahitaji kiasi gani zaidi? 8 + ? = 10.
s07.math.lesson.02.steps.3.narration: Tumechukua 2 hiyo kutoka kwa 7. Sasa itoe: 7 - 2.
s07.math.lesson.02.steps.6.feedback: Njia hiyo hufanya kazi kila mara.
s07.math.lesson.02.steps.6.narration: Kwa hiyo 8 + 7 = 15. Kutengeneza kumi kumefanya hesabu ngumu kuwa rahisi.
s07.math.lesson.02.steps.8.feedback: 10 na 5 ni 15. Umefanya kwa njia ya werevu!
s07.math.lesson.02.steps.8.narration: Chukua 1 kutoka kwa 6 ili ufike kumi, kisha jumlisha kilichobaki.
s07.math.lesson.02.steps.9.feedback: 12! Kutengeneza kumi hufanya kazi kila wakati.
s07.math.lesson.02.title: Jumlisha hadi 20
s07.math.lesson.03.steps.0.narration: Kutoa kunaweza kutumia njia ile ile ya kumi. Jaribu 15 − 7.
s07.math.lesson.03.steps.1.feedback: Kumi ni mahali rahisi pa kusimama.
s07.math.lesson.03.steps.1.narration: Badala ya kutoa 7 zote mara moja, tunashuka hadi kumi kwanza.
s07.math.lesson.03.steps.4.narration: Toa 2 za mwisho kutoka kwa kumi yetu.
s07.math.lesson.03.steps.5.narration: Shuka hadi kumi, kisha shuka tena. Hiyo ndiyo njia yote.
s07.math.lesson.03.steps.6.narration: Hii inafika kumi kwa hatua moja.
s07.math.lesson.03.steps.7.feedback: 9! Nne kufika kumi, kisha moja zaidi.
s07.math.lesson.03.steps.7.narration: 14 − 5. Shuka hadi kumi, kisha toa kilichobaki.
s07.math.lesson.03.title: Toa hadi 20
s07.math.lesson.04.steps.0.narration: Namba kubwa zimeundwa na makumi na mamoja. Angalia 47.
s07.math.lesson.04.steps.1.feedback: Mahali tarakimu inaposimama hubadilisha thamani yake.
s07.math.lesson.04.steps.1.narration: 4 si nne hasa. Inamaanisha mafungu manne ya kumi: 40.
s07.math.lesson.04.steps.3.narration: Mamoja yaliyobaki ni yale yasiyoweza kufanya fungu.
s07.math.lesson.04.steps.4.feedback: Kila namba ya tarakimu mbili hufanya hivi.
s07.math.lesson.04.steps.4.narration: Sema kwa sauti: arobaini… saba. Namba yenyewe inakuambia sehemu zake.
s07.math.lesson.04.steps.5.narration: Sasa kinyume: unda namba kutoka sehemu zake.
s07.math.lesson.04.steps.5.prompt: Ni namba ipi yenye makumi 6 na mamoja 2?
s07.math.lesson.04.steps.6.narration: Kuwa makini na hii. Hakuna mamoja yaliyobaki kabisa.
s07.math.lesson.04.steps.7.narration: Makumi yana thamani zaidi ya mamoja, kwa hiyo angalia makumi kwanza.
s07.math.lesson.04.steps.8.narration: Ya mwisho: unda makumi 5 na mamoja 9.
s07.math.lesson.04.title: Makumi na vimoja hadi 99
s07.math.lesson.05.parentNote: Onyesheni saa kamili kwenye saa halisi pamoja.
s07.math.lesson.05.recap.1.prompt: Mkono mdogo kwenye 3, mkubwa kwenye 12. Ni saa ngapi?
s07.math.lesson.05.steps.0.narration: Mkono mkubwa uko 12, mkono mdogo uko 3. Ni saa 3 kamili. Gusa saa 3.
s07.math.lesson.05.steps.2.feedback: Saa 7 kamili. Mkono mdogo hutaja saa.
s07.math.lesson.05.steps.2.narration: Mkono mdogo kwenye 7, mkubwa kwenye 12. Gusa saa 7 kamili.
s07.math.lesson.05.steps.3.feedback: Safari hiyo yote ni saa moja.
s07.math.lesson.05.steps.3.narration: Tazama: mkono mkubwa huzunguka kabisa huku mdogo ukisogea namba moja.
s07.math.lesson.05.steps.4.feedback: Saa 9 kamili. Mkono mkubwa juu, mdogo kwenye 9.
s07.math.lesson.05.steps.4.narration: Weka saa kwenye saa 9 kamili. Gusa 9.
s07.math.lesson.05.steps.5.feedback: Umesoma wakati halisi kwenye saa halisi.
s07.math.lesson.05.steps.5.narration: Shule huanza saa 8 kamili. Gusa saa inayoonyesha hivyo.
s07.math.lesson.05.steps.6.feedback: 4! Mkono mdogo kwa saa, kila mara.
s07.math.lesson.05.steps.6.narration: Mkono mdogo upo kwenye 4 na mkubwa kwenye 12. Ni saa ngapi?
s07.math.lesson.05.steps.7.feedback: Sasa unaweza kusoma saa ya ukutani.
s07.math.lesson.05.steps.7.narration: Mkono mkubwa kwenye 12 maana yake saa kamili, na mdogo husema ipi.
s07.math.lesson.05.title: Soma saa kamili
s07.math.lesson.06.parentNote: Panga na uhesabu sarafu pamoja (tumia sarafu ya eneo lenu).
s07.math.lesson.06.recap.0.prompt: Sarafu mbili za thamani 5 kila moja hufanya…
s07.math.lesson.06.recap.1.prompt: Sarafu moja kati ya hizo ina thamani gani peke yake?
s07.math.lesson.06.steps.0.feedback: Ukubwa hauonyeshi thamani. Namba ndiyo inayoonyesha.
s07.math.lesson.06.steps.0.narration: Sarafu ni ndogo, lakini kila moja ina thamani tofauti.
s07.math.lesson.06.steps.1.feedback: 10 ina thamani zaidi ya 5, hata kama sarafu inaonekana ndogo.
s07.math.lesson.06.steps.1.narration: Soma namba iliyo kwenye kila sarafu.
s07.math.lesson.06.steps.2.feedback: Sarafu tatu, lakini bado hatujui ni pesa kiasi gani.
s07.math.lesson.06.steps.2.narration: Gusa kila sarafu kwenye rundo ili uzihesabu.
s07.math.lesson.06.steps.3.feedback: Ili kupata pesa, jumlisha thamani zake.
s07.math.lesson.06.steps.3.narration: Kuhesabu sarafu si sawa na kuhesabu pesa.
s07.math.lesson.06.steps.5.feedback: 16. Jumlisha kubwa kwanza. Ni rahisi zaidi.
s07.math.lesson.06.steps.6.feedback: 20 ni zaidi ya 15, kwa hiyo unaweza kulinunua.
s07.math.lesson.06.steps.6.prompt: Una pesa za kutosha kununua embe?
s07.math.lesson.06.steps.7.feedback: Unarudishiwa 5. Sasa unajua kuangalia chenji yako.
s07.math.lesson.06.steps.7.narration: Muuzaji anarudisha kilichobaki. Hiyo ndiyo chenji yako.
s07.math.lesson.06.steps.8.narration: Wakati mwingine sarafu tofauti hufanya kiasi kile kile.
s07.math.lesson.06.title: Sarafu na pesa

s07.math.story.01.pages.2.narration: Jumanne sarafu nyingine ya 5. Hesabu naye: 5, 10!
s07.math.story.01.pages.4.narration: Lakini dukani anaona tiara ndogo ya 5.
s07.math.story.01.pages.5.narration: Ananunua ile aliyoiwekea akiba, na anaendelea kuhesabu. Inapaa!

s07.math.story.02.pages.2.narration: Saa 8 kamili. Saa mbili nzima za kusubiri. Anavuta pumzi.
s07.math.story.02.pages.3.narration: Anasaidia bustanini hadi mkono mkubwa unapozunguka tena.

s07.reading.lesson.01.recap.0.prompt: Ongeza silent-e kwenye cap. Unapata neno gani?
s07.reading.lesson.01.recap.1.prompt: Herufi a na i hutoa sauti gani katika rain?
s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.1.feedback: Neno limebadilika, na sauti ya katikati pia.
s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.1.narration: Sasa tazama. Tunaongeza herufi moja mwishoni: cape.
s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.2.feedback: cape. e ipo lakini inakaa kimya.
s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.2.narration: Soma tena: cape. e mpya haisemwi. Huwa husemi kwa sauti.
s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.3.feedback: cap inakuwa cape. hop inakuwa hope.
s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.3.narration: Hii ndiyo ajabu: e isiyosemwa hufanya vokali isome jina lake. A inasema 'ei'.
s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.4.feedback: hope inayo. hop na hopping hazina.
s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.4.narration: Tafuta e ya kimya mwishoni mwa neno.
s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.5.narration: Kuna njia ya pili vokali kusaidiana. Vokali mbili pamoja, sauti moja: rain.
s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.6.narration: Tafuta herufi mbili zinazofanya kazi katika rain.
s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.7.feedback: train! Timu ile ile, sauti ile ile.
s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.7.narration: Sikiliza sauti ile ile ya /ei/ katika neno lingine.
s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.7.prompt: Neno lipi lina sauti sawa na rain?
s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.8.feedback: Maneno manne mapya kutoka mtindo mmoja.
s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.8.narration: Ukiona timu unaweza kusoma familia nzima: rain, pain, mail, tail.
s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.9.feedback: tail. A na i tena. Sasa unasoma kwa mitindo.
s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.9.narration: Soma sentensi hii: 'The tail is long.'
s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.9.prompt: Neno lipi lina timu ya vokali?
s07.reading.lesson.01.title: E kimya na timu za irabu
s07.reading.lesson.02.recap.0.prompt: Ni neno lipi lina sauti fupi ya a?
s07.reading.lesson.02.steps.1.feedback: '/ei/. A ndefu, cape! E hufanya a kutamka jina lake.'
s07.reading.lesson.02.steps.3.feedback: kit inakuwa kite. Herufi moja, neno jipya kabisa.
s07.reading.lesson.02.steps.3.narration: Tazama: ongeza e kimya na irabu husema jina lake mwenyewe.
s07.reading.lesson.02.steps.4.feedback: /ai/. i ndefu. e ndiyo imefanya hivyo!
s07.reading.lesson.02.steps.5.narration: Kimoja kina irabu ndefu: hat, hate, ham. Iguse.
s07.reading.lesson.02.steps.6.feedback: cape. Herufi tatu zile zile pamoja na e.
s07.reading.lesson.02.steps.6.narration: Je, 'cap' au 'cape' lina a ndefu? Gusa 'cape'.
s07.reading.lesson.02.steps.7.feedback: e kimya mwishoni ndiyo dalili yako.
s07.reading.lesson.02.steps.7.narration: Irabu fupi husema sauti yake; ndefu husema jina lake.
s07.reading.lesson.02.title: Irabu fupi na ndefu
s07.reading.lesson.03.recap.1.prompt: Ni mwambatano upi huanza neno star: st au bl?
s07.reading.lesson.03.steps.0.feedback: /b/ na /l/, karibu pamoja lakini zote zipo.
s07.reading.lesson.03.steps.0.narration: Wakati mwingine herufi mbili husimama pamoja na unasikia zote. Sikiliza: bl katika black.
s07.reading.lesson.03.steps.1.narration: Sema black polepole na sikiliza mwanzo kabisa.
s07.reading.lesson.03.steps.2.feedback: Sauti 2. Unaweza kuzisikia zote ukienda polepole.
s07.reading.lesson.03.steps.2.narration: Mchanganyiko ni sauti mbili, si sauti mpya moja.
s07.reading.lesson.03.steps.3.feedback: Jifunze mchanganyiko mmoja, fungua maneno mengi.
s07.reading.lesson.03.steps.3.narration: Michanganyiko pia ina familia: st katika stop, star, stand.
s07.reading.lesson.03.steps.4.narration: Ni lipi kati ya haya linaanza na sauti hiyo ya st?
s07.reading.lesson.03.steps.5.feedback: nd. Sauti zote mbili, mwishoni kabisa.
s07.reading.lesson.03.steps.5.narration: Michanganyiko inaweza kujificha mwishoni mwa neno pia. Sikiliza mwisho wa hand: /n/ /d/.
s07.reading.lesson.03.steps.6.narration: Sema kila moja na sikiliza sehemu ya mwisho.
s07.reading.lesson.03.steps.7.narration: Hili ni neno jipya la kutamka: frog.
s07.reading.lesson.03.steps.8.narration: bl, st, nd, fr. Sasa unaweza kutamka maneno ambayo hujawahi kuyaona.
s07.reading.lesson.03.title: Michanganyiko ya konsonanti
s07.reading.lesson.04.recap.0.prompt: 'The girl kicks the ball.' Nani anapiga teke?
s07.reading.lesson.04.recap.1.prompt: Katika sentensi hiyo, ni nini kinapigwa teke?
s07.reading.lesson.04.steps.0.narration: Soma: 'The girl kicks the ball.' Nani anapiga teke? Gusa msichana.
s07.reading.lesson.04.steps.2.narration: Soma: 'The boy feeds the cat.' Nani analisha? Gusa mvulana.
s07.reading.lesson.04.steps.3.feedback: Pata hivyo viwili na utakuwa umeielewa.
s07.reading.lesson.04.steps.3.narration: Tazama: kila sentensi hujibu nani, na walifanya nini.
s07.reading.lesson.04.steps.4.narration: Katika 'The girl reads a book', gusa anachosoma.
s07.reading.lesson.04.steps.5.feedback: Mto. Sentensi zinaweza kujibu wapi pia.
s07.reading.lesson.04.steps.5.narration: 'The dog runs to the river.' Gusa anakokimbilia.
s07.reading.lesson.04.steps.6.narration: Katika 'The cat sleeps on the bed', nani analala? Gusa paka.
s07.reading.lesson.04.steps.7.feedback: Hiyo ni kusoma kwa maana, si sauti tu.
s07.reading.lesson.04.steps.7.narration: Nani, nini, wapi — maswali matatu kwa sentensi yoyote.
s07.reading.lesson.04.title: Soma kwa maana
s07.reading.lesson.05.recap.0.prompt: Kusimulia tena huenda mwanzo, katikati, na…
s07.reading.lesson.05.steps.0.narration: Panga sehemu za hadithi kwa mpangilio: mwanzo, katikati, mwisho.
s07.reading.lesson.05.steps.2.narration: Simulia nyingine: mbegu, kisha chipukizi, kisha ua. Buruta kwa mpangilio.
s07.reading.lesson.05.steps.3.feedback: Si kila neno — mifupa ya hadithi tu.
s07.reading.lesson.05.steps.3.narration: Tazama: kusimulia hushika muhimu na kuacha mengine.
s07.reading.lesson.05.steps.4.feedback: Kupotea, kupatikana, nyumbani. Hiyo ndiyo hadithi nzima.
s07.reading.lesson.05.steps.4.narration: Simulia hadithi ya mbwa aliyepotea kwa sehemu tatu. Buruta kwa mpangilio.
s07.reading.lesson.05.steps.5.narration: Sehemu ipi inakuambia iliishaje? Gusa sehemu ya mwisho.
s07.reading.lesson.05.steps.6.narration: Je, kusimulia kunahitaji kila neno moja? Gusa hapana.
s07.reading.lesson.05.steps.7.feedback: Kusimulia ndiyo njia ya kuthibitisha umeelewa.
s07.reading.lesson.05.steps.7.narration: Mwanzo, katikati, mwisho — kwa maneno yako mwenyewe.
s07.reading.lesson.05.title: Simulia hadithi tena
s07.reading.lesson.06.recap.0.prompt: Maandishi yanaeleza jinsi mnyama anavyokula, kucheza na kulala. Wazo kuu ni…
s07.reading.lesson.06.steps.0.feedback: Sentensi moja hadi sasa. Endelea kusikiliza.
s07.reading.lesson.06.steps.0.narration: Sikiliza hadithi hii ndogo. 'Nyuki wanaishi pamoja katika mzinga.'
s07.reading.lesson.06.steps.1.feedback: Sentensi tatu zaidi. Angalia zote zinahusu nini.
s07.reading.lesson.06.steps.1.narration: 'Nyuki wengine hutafuta maua. Wengine hutengeneza asali. Wengine husafisha mzinga.'
s07.reading.lesson.06.steps.2.feedback: Asali. Hayo ni maelezo. Ukweli mmoja kutoka sentensi moja.
s07.reading.lesson.06.steps.2.narration: Kabla ya kufikiria hadithi nzima, angalia kitu kimoja ulichosikia.
s07.reading.lesson.06.steps.3.feedback: Inahusu zaidi nyuki wanaofanya kazi pamoja.
s07.reading.lesson.06.steps.3.narration: Kila sentensi imezungumzia nyuki wakifanya kazi.
s07.reading.lesson.06.steps.4.feedback: Ni hadithi yote kwa maneno machache.
s07.reading.lesson.06.steps.4.narration: Hilo ndilo wazo kuu: sentensi nyingi zinahusu nini.
s07.reading.lesson.06.steps.5.feedback: 'Wengine hutengeneza asali' ni maelezo madogo, si wazo lote.
s07.reading.lesson.06.steps.5.narration: Sentensi nyingine ni maelezo. Zinakamilisha picha.
s07.reading.lesson.06.steps.5.prompt: Ni ipi ni maelezo, si wazo kuu?
s07.reading.lesson.06.steps.6.feedback: Vichwa ni kidokezo cha hadithi inahusu nini.
s07.reading.lesson.06.steps.6.narration: Kichwa kizuri ni wazo kuu, kikifanywa kifupi.
s07.reading.lesson.06.steps.7.feedback: 'Nyuki Wenye Shughuli'. Kifupi, na kinasema wazo kuu.
s07.reading.lesson.06.steps.7.narration: Chagua kichwa kinachofaa hadithi yetu ya nyuki.
s07.reading.lesson.06.steps.8.narration: Sasa hadithi mpya kabisa. 'Mvua inajaza mto. Mimea inanywa. Wanyama wanakuja kwa maji.'
s07.reading.lesson.06.steps.9.feedback: Mvua husaidia uhai. Umepata wazo kuu mwenyewe!
s07.reading.lesson.06.steps.9.narration: Tafuta wazo linaloshikilia sentensi zote tatu.
s07.reading.lesson.06.title: Wazo kuu

s07.science.lesson.01.steps.0.narration: Vipange kwa mpangilio. Nini kinakuja kwanza?
s07.science.lesson.01.steps.2.feedback: Yai kwanza hapa pia. Wanyama wengi huanza hivyo!
s07.science.lesson.01.steps.2.narration: Panga mzunguko wa maisha ya chura: yai, kiluwiluwi, chura.
s07.science.lesson.01.steps.3.feedback: Ndiyo maana tunauita mzunguko na si mstari.
s07.science.lesson.01.steps.3.narration: Tazama: mzunguko wa maisha huzunguka. Kipepeo hutaga yai tena.
s07.science.lesson.01.steps.4.feedback: Kazi iliyofichwa. Huingia kiwavi na kutoka kipepeo.
s07.science.lesson.01.steps.4.narration: Ndani ya kifukofuko kiwavi hubadilika kabisa. Gusa kifukofuko.
s07.science.lesson.01.steps.5.feedback: Na mzunguko unaanza tena. Duara na duara.
s07.science.lesson.01.steps.5.narration: Kipepeo hutaga yai lake juu ya jani. Gusa jani.
s07.science.lesson.01.steps.6.narration: Nini huja mara baada ya yai? Gusa kiwavi.
s07.science.lesson.01.steps.7.feedback: Sasa unaweza kusoma mzunguko wa maisha, kwa mnyama yeyote.

s07.science.lesson.02.steps.2.feedback: Kiwavi hufuata mara baada ya yai.
s07.science.lesson.02.steps.2.narration: Weka hatua mbili za kwanza kwa mpangilio kichwani mwako.
s07.science.lesson.02.steps.2.prompt: Nini hufuata mara baada ya yai?
s07.science.lesson.02.steps.3.narration: Kisha kiwavi hujitengenezea kifuko kigumu. Kifuko hicho ni buu.
s07.science.lesson.02.steps.4.narration: Ndani ya buu kuna shughuli nyingi sana.
s07.science.lesson.02.steps.5.feedback: Mnyama yule yule. Umbo jipya kabisa.
s07.science.lesson.02.steps.5.narration: Kifuko hufunguka na kipepeo hutoka na mabawa mapya.
s07.science.lesson.02.steps.6.narration: Sasa weka zote nne kwa mpangilio: yai, kiwavi, buu, kipepeo.
s07.science.lesson.02.steps.7.feedback: Hatua 4, kila wakati kwa mpangilio ule ule.
s07.science.lesson.02.steps.8.narration: Kisha kipepeo hutaga mayai, na yote huanza tena.

s07.science.lesson.03.steps.2.feedback: Mifupa midogo mingi kwenye mkono mmoja!
s07.science.lesson.03.steps.2.narration: Mifupa hukusimamisha na kukupa umbo. Gusa mkono.
s07.science.lesson.03.steps.3.feedback: Mwili ni kazi nyingi zinazofanyika kwa wakati mmoja.
s07.science.lesson.03.steps.3.narration: Tazama: moyo husukuma, mapafu hupumua, mifupa hushikilia. Kila sehemu ina kazi moja.
s07.science.lesson.03.steps.4.feedback: Msuli na mfupa hufanya kazi kama jozi.
s07.science.lesson.03.steps.4.narration: Misuli huvuta mifupa yako ili uweze kusogea. Gusa mkono wa juu.

s07.science.lesson.05.steps.7.narration: Kitu hutetemeka, hewa huipeleka, sikio lako husikia.

s07.social.lesson.01.steps.2.narration: Afrika ni bara lenye ikweta inayolipita. Gusa Afrika.
s07.social.lesson.01.steps.3.feedback: Maji hufunika sehemu kubwa zaidi kuliko nchi kavu.
s07.social.lesson.01.steps.3.narration: Tazama: mabara saba ya nchi kavu, bahari tano za maji, dunia moja.
s07.social.lesson.01.steps.4.feedback: Pasifiki. Ni kubwa kuliko nchi kavu yote kwa pamoja.
s07.social.lesson.01.steps.4.narration: Tafuta bahari kubwa zaidi kisha iguse.
s07.social.lesson.01.steps.5.feedback: Hapo ndipo nyumbani, kwenye tufe la dunia.
s07.social.lesson.01.steps.6.feedback: Maji. Mabara ni nchi kavu iliyo kati yake.
s07.social.lesson.01.steps.6.narration: Je, bahari ni nchi kavu au maji? Gusa maji.
s07.social.lesson.01.steps.7.feedback: Unaweza kupata mahali pako juu yake.
s07.social.lesson.01.steps.7.narration: Mabara saba, bahari tano, sayari moja.
s07.social.lesson.01.title: Mabara na bahari
s07.social.lesson.02.recap.0.prompt: Ni kipi ni duara kama Dunia?
s07.social.lesson.02.recap.1.prompt: Ni kipi ni bapa na rahisi kubeba?
s07.social.lesson.02.steps.0.narration: Tufe ni mfano wa mviringo wa Dunia. Gusa tufe.
s07.social.lesson.02.steps.1.narration: Ramani ni tambarare na huonyesha maeneo. Gusa ramani.
s07.social.lesson.02.steps.2.feedback: Duara kama dunia, hivyo hakuna kinachonyooshwa.
s07.social.lesson.02.steps.2.narration: Tufe huonyesha umbo halisi; ramani bapa hulazimika kulinyoosha. Gusa tufe.
s07.social.lesson.02.steps.3.feedback: Ndiyo maana kila ramani bapa hukosea kidogo.
s07.social.lesson.02.steps.3.narration: Tazama: huwezi kubapisha mpira bila kuurarua au kuunyoosha.
s07.social.lesson.02.steps.4.feedback: Bapa na rahisi kubeba. Ndiyo madhumuni ya ramani.
s07.social.lesson.02.steps.4.narration: Ramani hukunjwa na kuingia mfukoni. Gusa ramani.
s07.social.lesson.02.steps.5.feedback: Popote! Nenda mbali vya kutosha na utarudi.
s07.social.lesson.02.steps.6.narration: Kipi ni duara kama dunia: ramani au tufe? Gusa tufe.
s07.social.lesson.02.steps.7.narration: Tufe kwa ukweli, ramani kwa mfukoni.
s07.social.lesson.02.title: Ramani na tufe
s07.social.lesson.03.parentNote: Zungumzeni kuhusu sheria ya jamii na jinsi inavyosaidia.
s07.social.lesson.03.recap.0.prompt: Kutembea badala ya kukimbia shuleni ni…
s07.social.lesson.03.recap.1.prompt: Magari kusimama kwenye taa nyekundu ni…
s07.social.lesson.03.steps.0.narration: Sheria shuleni: tembea, usikimbie ndani. Gusa kutembea salama.
s07.social.lesson.03.steps.1.narration: Sheria kwa wote: magari husimama kwenye taa nyekundu. Gusa taa nyekundu.
s07.social.lesson.03.steps.2.feedback: Nyumba nazo zina sheria. Kundi dogo, wazo lile lile.
s07.social.lesson.03.steps.2.narration: Sheria ya nyumbani: viatu nje mlangoni. Gusa kiatu.
s07.social.lesson.03.steps.3.narration: Tazama: sheria ndogo ni ya mahali pamoja, sheria kuu ni ya kila mtu nchini.
s07.social.lesson.03.steps.4.feedback: Kila mtu, kila gari. Ndiyo inayoifanya kuwa sheria.
s07.social.lesson.03.steps.4.narration: Sheria: kila mtu huvaa mkanda garini. Gusa mkanda.
s07.social.lesson.03.steps.5.feedback: Sheria hazishushwi. Watu hukubaliana juu yake.
s07.social.lesson.03.steps.5.narration: Watu wazima huchagua sheria pamoja kwa kupiga kura. Gusa unyooshe mkono.
s07.social.lesson.03.steps.6.feedback: Sheria ndogo — ni ya shule moja, si nchi nzima.
s07.social.lesson.03.steps.6.narration: Je, 'tembea ndani' ni sheria ndogo au sheria kuu? Gusa sheria ndogo.
s07.social.lesson.03.steps.7.feedback: Vyote vipo ili watu washiriki mahali kwa usalama.
s07.social.lesson.03.steps.7.narration: Sheria ndogo kwa mahali, sheria kuu kwa kila mtu.
s07.social.lesson.03.title: Sheria na kanuni
s07.social.lesson.04.recap.1.prompt: Nani hutumia bomba la maji kuzima moto?
s07.social.lesson.04.steps.0.narration: Daktari hutumia stethoskopu. Ivute kwa daktari.
s07.social.lesson.04.steps.1.narration: Mzima-moto hutumia bomba la maji. Livute kwa mzima-moto.
s07.social.lesson.04.steps.2.narration: Mwalimu hutumia kitabu. Kiburute hadi kwa mwalimu.
s07.social.lesson.04.steps.3.feedback: Bomba kwa moto, kitabu kwa kufundisha. Hakuna cha bahati.
s07.social.lesson.04.steps.3.narration: Tazama: kifaa hukuambia kazi, kwa sababu kila kimoja hulingana na kazi yake.
s07.social.lesson.04.steps.4.narration: Mkulima hutumia jembe. Liburute hadi kwa mkulima.
s07.social.lesson.04.steps.5.narration: Kila msaidizi hapa hufanya kazi kwa ajili ya jamii. Gusa daktari.
s07.social.lesson.04.steps.6.feedback: Mzima moto. Kifaa hulingana na kazi.
s07.social.lesson.04.steps.6.narration: Nani angetumia bomba: mzima moto au mwalimu? Gusa mzima moto.
s07.social.lesson.04.steps.7.narration: Daktari, mzima moto, mwalimu, mkulima — na vifaa vyao.
s07.social.lesson.04.title: Wasaidizi na vifaa vyao
s07.social.lesson.05.recap.1.prompt: Maisha ya familia hufanya nini kadri muda unavyopita?
s07.social.lesson.05.steps.0.narration: Zamani, familia zilifua nguo kwa mkono. Gusa ubao wa kufulia.
s07.social.lesson.05.steps.1.narration: Sasa wengi hutumia mashine ya kufulia. Iguse.
s07.social.lesson.05.steps.2.feedback: Kila mlo ulianza kwa kuwasha moto.
s07.social.lesson.05.steps.2.narration: Zamani, familia zilipika kwa moto. Gusa moto.
s07.social.lesson.05.steps.3.feedback: Watu bado hupika, hufua na kuchota maji.
s07.social.lesson.05.steps.3.narration: Tazama: kazi ambazo familia hufanya hazijabadilika. Vifaa vimebadilika.
s07.social.lesson.05.steps.4.feedback: Kila siku, kwa mikono. Sasa bomba hufanya hivyo.
s07.social.lesson.05.steps.4.narration: Zamani, maji yalichotwa mtoni. Gusa mto.
s07.social.lesson.05.steps.5.feedback: Familia yako mwenyewe inashikilia historia hii.
s07.social.lesson.05.steps.5.narration: Muulize mtu mzima jikoni kwao kulikuwa na nini. Gusa sufuria walilolieleza.
s07.social.lesson.05.steps.6.narration: Je, familia bado zinahitaji kula na kufua leo? Gusa ndiyo.
s07.social.lesson.05.steps.7.narration: Zamani na sasa, kazi zile zile za familia.
s07.social.lesson.05.title: Familia zamani na sasa
s07.social.lesson.06.parentNote: Sifu upokezanaji wa haki wa zamu unapokuona.
s07.social.lesson.06.recap.0.prompt: Marafiki wawili na bembea moja. Ni jambo gani la haki?
s07.social.lesson.06.steps.0.narration: Marafiki wawili, pembea moja. Jambo la haki ni kuPOKEZANA zamu. Gusa kupokezana.
s07.social.lesson.06.steps.1.narration: Kugawana muda kwa haki huwafurahisha wote.
s07.social.lesson.06.steps.2.feedback: Zamu huleta haki wakati hakuna vya kutosha.
s07.social.lesson.06.steps.2.narration: Marafiki watatu, viti viwili. Gusa mshirikiane kwa zamu.
s07.social.lesson.06.steps.3.feedback: Mtoto mrefu hahitaji sanduku lile lile kuona ng'ambo ya uzio.
s07.social.lesson.06.steps.3.narration: Tazama: haki si daima maana yake sawa. Ni kile kila mmoja anachohitaji.
s07.social.lesson.06.steps.4.feedback: Kumjumuisha mtu hakukugharimu chochote na hubadilisha siku yake.
s07.social.lesson.06.steps.4.narration: Mtu ameachwa nje ya mchezo. Gusa umkaribishe.
s07.social.lesson.06.steps.5.feedback: Nusu kila mmoja. Wakati mwingine haki ni rahisi.
s07.social.lesson.06.steps.5.narration: Watoto wawili wanataka tufaha la mwisho. Gusa uligawe nusu.
s07.social.lesson.06.steps.6.feedback: Hapana. Haki humjumuisha kila anayetaka kucheza.
s07.social.lesson.06.steps.6.narration: Je, kumwacha mtu nje ni haki? Gusa hapana.
s07.social.lesson.06.steps.7.feedback: Hiyo ni haki, na unaweza kufanya yote matatu.
s07.social.lesson.06.steps.7.narration: Peaneni zamu, gawaneni, mjumuishe kila mtu.
s07.social.lesson.06.title: Kuwa na haki

s07.social.quiz.01.questions.0.retryFeed: Hitaji hutuweka na afya na hai. Jaribu tena!
s07.social.quiz.01.questions.1.correctFe: Baiskeli ni nzuri, lakini hakuna anayeihitaji ili aishi.
s07.social.quiz.01.questions.1.retryFeed: Ungeweza kuishi bila kipi? Jaribu tena!
s07.social.quiz.01.questions.2.correctFe: Hitaji. Kila mtu anahitaji mahali salama na pakavu.
s07.social.quiz.01.questions.2.prompt: Je, makazi ni hitaji au tamanio?
s07.social.quiz.01.questions.2.retryFeed: Nini hutokea wakati wa dhoruba bila paa? Jaribu tena!

s07.social.quiz.02.parentNote: Jaribuni kubapisha ganda la chungwa pamoja. Ndiyo njia wazi zaidi ya kuonyesha kwa nini ramani bapa hunyoosha vitu.
s07.social.quiz.02.questions.0.retryFeed: Tufe lina umbo la mpira. Jaribu tena!
s07.social.quiz.02.questions.2.correctFe: Maji, kwa mbali. Angalia tufe na ni wazi.
s07.social.quiz.02.questions.2.prompt: Kipi hufunika sehemu kubwa ya dunia: nchi kavu au maji?
s07.social.quiz.02.questions.2.retryFeed: Kuna rangi ipi zaidi? Jaribu tena!
s07.social.quiz.02.questions.3.correctFe: Sahihi. Kila ramani bapa hukosea kidogo.
s07.social.quiz.02.questions.3.prompt: Kwa nini ramani bapa haiwi sahihi kabisa?
s07.social.quiz.02.questions.3.retryFeed: Jaribu kubapisha ganda la chungwa. Jaribu tena!

s07.social.quiz.03.questions.1.retryFeed: Je, inatumika kila mahali nchini? Jaribu tena!
s07.social.quiz.03.questions.2.correctFe: Zamu. Haki maana yake kila mmoja anapata sehemu ya muda.
s07.social.quiz.03.questions.2.prompt: Watoto watatu, bembea mbili. Jambo la haki ni lipi?
s07.social.quiz.03.questions.2.retryFeed: Mtoto wa tatu angejisikiaje? Jaribu tena!

s07.social.quiz.04.questions.0.retryFeed: Nani husikiliza kifua chako? Jaribu tena!

s07.social.quiz.04.questions.2.retryFeed: Je, kulikuwa na mashine wakati huo? Jaribu tena!

s07.social.quiz.04.title: Wasaidizi na Historia
s07.social.story.01.pages.0.narration: Darasa halikuweza kukubaliana: hadithi, au wimbo?
s07.social.story.01.pages.1.narration: Wengine walipiga kelele zaidi. Hilo halikumaliza chochote.
s07.social.story.01.pages.2.narration: Bi Bello alisema, 'Tupige kura. Kila mkono huhesabika sawa.'
s07.social.story.01.pages.3.narration: Kila mtoto alinyoosha mkono mara moja. Walihesabu pamoja.
s07.social.story.01.pages.4.narration: Wimbo ulishinda kwa mbili. Ada alitaka hadithi, na alisema hivyo.
s07.social.story.01.pages.5.narration: Kisha aliimba hata hivyo. Kupiga kura ni haki hata siku unaposhindwa.
s07.social.story.01.parentNote: Mwache mtoto wako apige kura juu ya chaguo dogo la familia — na shikilia matokeo hata akishindwa. Hilo ndilo somo.
s07.social.story.01.title: Kura ya Darasa
s07.social.story.02.pages.0.narration: Babu alitandaza ramani kubwa sakafuni na kuweka kidole chake.
s07.social.story.02.pages.1.narration: 'Hapa ndipo tulipo,' alisema. 'Afrika. Ikweta hupita hapa.'
s07.social.story.02.pages.2.narration: Kidole chake kilivuka nafasi pana ya buluu. 'Hiyo ni bahari.'
s07.social.story.02.pages.3.narration: Ilichukua muda mrefu kuvuka, hata kwenye karatasi.
s07.social.story.02.pages.4.narration: 'Maji hufunika sehemu kubwa kuliko nchi kavu,' alisema. 'Angalia.'
s07.social.story.02.pages.5.narration: Mabara saba, bahari tano, na nyumba yao kwenye moja wapo.
s07.social.story.02.parentNote: Fuatilia njia kwenye ramani au tufe halisi mnaposoma. Kupata nchi yenu kwanza husaidia.
s07.social.story.02.title: Safari Ndefu Zaidi
s07.writing.lesson.01.recap.0.prompt: Katika 'The happy dog runs', ni neno lipi ni jina?
s07.writing.lesson.01.recap.1.prompt: Katika sentensi hiyo, ni neno lipi ni kitendo?
s07.writing.lesson.01.steps.0.narration: Nomino ni mtu, mahali, au kitu. Gusa nomino: 'The happy dog runs.'
s07.writing.lesson.01.steps.3.narration: Katika 'The small bird sings', gusa nomino.
s07.writing.lesson.01.steps.4.feedback: Kazi tatu. Kila sentensi hutumia angalau mbili.
s07.writing.lesson.01.steps.4.narration: Tazama: nomino ni nani au nini, kitenzi ni kinachofanywa, kivumishi huelezea.
s07.writing.lesson.01.steps.5.feedback: 'small'. Vivumishi hukuambia kipi au cha aina gani.
s07.writing.lesson.01.steps.5.narration: Katika sentensi hiyo hiyo, gusa neno linaloelezea ndege.
s07.writing.lesson.01.steps.7.feedback: 'car'. Umepanga aina tatu za maneno mwenyewe.
s07.writing.lesson.01.steps.7.narration: Katika 'A red car stops', neno lipi ni nomino? Gusa 'car'.
s07.writing.lesson.01.steps.8.feedback: Sasa unaweza kutaja aina za maneno katika sentensi yoyote.
s07.writing.lesson.01.steps.8.narration: Nomino hutaja, kitenzi hutenda, kivumishi huelezea.
s07.writing.lesson.01.title: Nomino, vitenzi, vivumishi
s07.writing.lesson.02.recap.1.prompt: Katika 'I go to school', ni neno lipi ni nomino?
s07.writing.lesson.02.steps.0.narration: Nomino hutaja mtu, mahali, au kitu. Gusa nomino: 'dog'.
s07.writing.lesson.02.steps.1.narration: Gusa nomino katika 'I go to school'. (school)
s07.writing.lesson.02.steps.2.narration: Nomino inaweza kuwa mtu. Gusa nomino katika 'The teacher smiles'.
s07.writing.lesson.02.steps.3.narration: Tazama: mtu, mahali au kitu. Ukiweza kuweka 'the' mbele, mara nyingi ni nomino.
s07.writing.lesson.02.steps.4.narration: Gusa nomino katika 'We walk to the river'.
s07.writing.lesson.02.steps.5.feedback: 'book'. Sentensi inaweza kuwa na zaidi ya moja.
s07.writing.lesson.02.steps.5.narration: Nomino mbili zimejificha katika 'The girl holds a book'. Gusa ya pili.
s07.writing.lesson.02.steps.7.feedback: Unaweza kuiona katika sentensi yoyote unayosoma.
s07.writing.lesson.02.steps.7.narration: Mtu, mahali au kitu — hiyo ni nomino.
s07.writing.lesson.02.title: Nomino: maneno ya kutaja
s07.writing.lesson.03.recap.1.prompt: Katika 'She runs fast', ni neno lipi ni kitenzi?
s07.writing.lesson.03.steps.0.narration: Maneno mengine ni vitu. Mengine ni matendo. Neno la tendo ni kitenzi.
s07.writing.lesson.03.steps.1.feedback: ruka ni tendo. Kiti ni kitu.
s07.writing.lesson.03.steps.2.feedback: 'Msichana anakimbia.' Bila anakimbia, msichana anasimama tu.
s07.writing.lesson.03.steps.2.narration: Kila sentensi inahitaji kitenzi, vinginevyo hakuna kinachotokea.
s07.writing.lesson.03.steps.3.narration: Tafuta neno la tendo katika sentensi hii: 'Mbwa anabweka.'
s07.writing.lesson.03.steps.4.feedback: Ikiwa ni kitu unachofanya, ni kitenzi.
s07.writing.lesson.03.steps.4.narration: Vitenzi si lazima viwe na sauti au haraka. Vitu tulivu pia ni vitenzi: fikiri, lala, subiri.
s07.writing.lesson.03.steps.5.narration: Unalala tuli unapofanya hili, lakini bado unalifanya.
s07.writing.lesson.03.steps.6.feedback: anasoma. Amina ni mtu, kitabu ni kitu, anasoma ni tendo.
s07.writing.lesson.03.steps.7.feedback: Ndege yule yule, matendo mawili tofauti.
s07.writing.lesson.03.steps.7.narration: Badilisha kitenzi na unabadilisha kinachotokea. 'Ndege anaimba.' 'Ndege anaruka.'
s07.writing.lesson.03.steps.8.feedback: anaruka. Bluu na meza si matendo.
s07.writing.lesson.03.steps.8.narration: Moja tu kati ya haya linaweza kukamilisha 'Ndege ___.'
s07.writing.lesson.03.title: Vitenzi: maneno ya vitendo
s07.writing.lesson.04.recap.1.prompt: Kila sentensi inahitaji mtenda na neno la…
s07.writing.lesson.04.steps.0.narration: Jenga sentensi: 'The' + 'cat' + 'sleeps'. Anza na herufi kubwa, maliza na nukta.
s07.writing.lesson.04.steps.1.narration: Kila sentensi inahitaji nani na neno la kitendo.
s07.writing.lesson.04.steps.2.feedback: 'A bird sings.' Nani na neno la kitendo.
s07.writing.lesson.04.steps.2.narration: Jenga nyingine: 'A' + 'bird' + 'sings'. Herufi kubwa mwanzoni, nukta mwishoni.
s07.writing.lesson.04.steps.3.feedback: 'The big red' haina kitenzi, hivyo bado haisemi chochote.
s07.writing.lesson.04.steps.3.narration: Tazama: sentensi inahitaji nomino na kitenzi, la sivyo haikamilishi wazo.
s07.writing.lesson.04.steps.4.feedback: 'The small cat sleeps.' Kivumishi kimeifanya iwe wazi zaidi.
s07.writing.lesson.04.steps.6.feedback: Ndiyo. Herufi kubwa kufungua, nukta kufunga.
s07.writing.lesson.04.steps.6.narration: Je, kila sentensi inahitaji herufi kubwa mwanzoni? Gusa ndiyo.
s07.writing.lesson.04.steps.7.feedback: Vitu vinne, na utakuwa umeandika sentensi.
s07.writing.lesson.04.steps.7.narration: Nomino, kitenzi, herufi kubwa na nukta.
s07.writing.lesson.04.title: Andika sentensi
s07.writing.lesson.05.recap.0.prompt: Gusa alama inayomaliza sentensi ya kuuliza.
s07.writing.lesson.05.steps.0.narration: Swali huuliza jambo na huishia na '?'. Gusa alama ya kuuliza.
s07.writing.lesson.05.steps.2.feedback: Alama ya kuuliza. Huonyesha sentensi inauliza.
s07.writing.lesson.05.steps.2.narration: 'What is your name?' Gusa alama iliyo mwishoni.
s07.writing.lesson.05.steps.3.feedback: Sauti yako hata hupanda mwishoni mwa swali.
s07.writing.lesson.05.steps.3.narration: Tazama: swali huuliza na kusubiri. Taarifa hueleza na kusimama.
s07.writing.lesson.05.steps.4.feedback: Where, what, who, when, why. Vianzio vizuri.
s07.writing.lesson.05.steps.4.narration: Maswali mara nyingi huanza na neno la kuuliza. Gusa 'Where'.
s07.writing.lesson.05.steps.5.feedback: 'Is the dog big?' Maneno hubadilishana na alama hubadilika.
s07.writing.lesson.05.steps.5.narration: Geuza 'The dog is big' kuwa swali. Gusa alama ya kuuliza kumaliza.
s07.writing.lesson.05.steps.6.narration: Kipi humaliza swali: nukta au alama ya kuuliza? Gusa alama ya kuuliza.
s07.writing.lesson.05.steps.7.feedback: Alama iliyo mwishoni humwambia msomaji ni ipi.

s08.reading.lesson.03.steps.0.narration: 'The thirsty dog drank from its bowl.' 'thirsty' maana yake nini?
s08.reading.lesson.03.steps.2.feedback: Wasomaji wazuri hukisia kutoka muktadha kwanza, kamusi baadaye.
s08.reading.lesson.03.steps.2.narration: Neno likiwa geni, sentensi inayolizunguka ndiyo dokezo.
s08.reading.lesson.03.steps.3.feedback: Si pana. Sentensi nzima ilikuambia, si neno lenyewe.
s08.reading.lesson.03.steps.3.narration: 'Daraja lilikuwa jembamba hivi kwamba mtu mmoja tu angeweza kupita.' Gusa maana ya jembamba.
s08.reading.lesson.03.steps.4.narration: 'Alikuwa na njaa kali, kwa hiyo alikula mabakuli mawili mazima.' Gusa maana ya njaa kali.
s08.reading.lesson.03.steps.5.feedback: 'The'. Sentensi moja fupi mara nyingi haina dokezo — soma inayofuata.
s08.reading.lesson.03.steps.5.narration: 'Mbwa alikuwa mkubwa mno.' Gusa neno katika sentensi hii AMBALO SI dokezo.
s08.reading.lesson.03.steps.6.feedback: Kunyesha kidogo tu. 'Kwa hiyo hatukuhitaji' ndilo dokezo.
s08.reading.lesson.03.steps.6.narration: 'Kulikuwa kukinyesha manyunyu, kwa hiyo hatukuhitaji miavuli.' Gusa maana ya manyunyu.
s08.reading.lesson.03.steps.7.narration: Wakati ujao ukikutana na neno usilolijua, maliza sentensi kwanza.
s08.reading.lesson.03.title: Vidokezo vya muktadha
s08.reading.lesson.04.recap.0.prompt: 'Maya played at the beach.' Nani ni mhusika?
s08.reading.lesson.04.recap.1.prompt: Katika sentensi hiyo, mandhari ni wapi?
s08.reading.lesson.04.steps.0.feedback: Maya. Mhusika ni yule hadithi inayomhusu.
s08.reading.lesson.04.steps.0.narration: 'Maya played at the beach.' Nani ni mhusika?
s08.reading.lesson.04.steps.2.feedback: Badilisha mandhari na mhusika yule yule ana hadithi tofauti.
s08.reading.lesson.04.steps.2.narration: Mhusika ni nani. Mandhari ni wapi na lini. Kila hadithi ina vyote.
s08.reading.lesson.04.steps.3.narration: 'Usiku wa baridi, Ravi alisubiri stesheni.' Gusa mhusika.
s08.reading.lesson.04.steps.4.feedback: 'Usiku wa baridi' na 'stesheni' — lini, na wapi.
s08.reading.lesson.04.steps.4.narration: Sentensi ile ile. Gusa maneno mawili yanayokupa mandhari.
s08.reading.lesson.04.steps.5.feedback: Kusubiri ni kinachotokea, si mahali. Hiyo ni ploti, si mandhari.
s08.reading.lesson.04.steps.5.narration: Mtu alisema mandhari ya hadithi hiyo ni 'kusubiri'. Gusa kwa nini si sahihi.
s08.reading.lesson.04.steps.6.feedback: Amina na mbwa ni nani. Soko na usiku wa manane ni wapi na lini.
s08.reading.lesson.04.steps.6.narration: Panga haya kuwa mhusika na mandhari: Amina, soko, usiku wa manane, mbwa mzee.
s08.reading.lesson.04.steps.7.feedback: Maswali mawili yanayofanya kazi kwa kila kitabu kilichowahi kuandikwa.
s08.reading.lesson.04.steps.7.narration: Mwishoni mwa hadithi yako ijayo, taja mhusika na mandhari kwa sauti.
s08.reading.lesson.04.title: Wahusika na mahali
s08.reading.lesson.05.recap.0.prompt: 'Anga ni buluu' inaweza kuthibitishwa, kwa hivyo ni…
s08.reading.lesson.05.recap.1.prompt: 'Buluu ndiyo rangi bora' ni hisia ya mtu, kwa hivyo ni…
s08.reading.lesson.05.steps.0.narration: 'The sky is blue' ni ukweli. Tunaweza kuuthibitisha. Gusa 'ukweli'.
s08.reading.lesson.05.steps.1.narration: 'Blue is the best color' ni maoni. Kile mtu anachohisi.
s08.reading.lesson.05.steps.2.feedback: Hicho ndicho kipimo chote: je, mtu angeweza kwenda kuthibitisha?
s08.reading.lesson.05.steps.2.narration: Ukweli unaweza kuthibitishwa, kama idadi ya viti chumbani. Maoni hayawezi.
s08.reading.lesson.05.steps.3.narration: 'Mti huu ni mrefu mita kumi.' Ukweli au maoni? Gusa jibu lako.
s08.reading.lesson.05.steps.4.feedback: Maoni. Hakuna njia ya kupima ubaya.
s08.reading.lesson.05.steps.4.narration: 'Mti huu ni mbaya.' Ukweli au maoni? Gusa jibu lako.
s08.reading.lesson.05.steps.5.feedback: 'Mbaya'. Kuanza na 'kila mtu anajua' hakugeuzi ladha kuwa ukweli.
s08.reading.lesson.05.steps.5.narration: 'Kila mtu anajua supu hii ni mbaya.' Gusa sehemu inayoifanya kuwa maoni.
s08.reading.lesson.05.steps.6.feedback: Mvua ni majimaji. Nyingine ni jinsi mtu anavyohisi kuhusu mvua.
s08.reading.lesson.05.steps.6.narration: Gusa sentensi iliyo ukweli: 'Mvua ni majimaji' au 'Siku za mvua ni za huzuni'.
s08.reading.lesson.05.steps.7.feedback: Kutambua tofauti ndiyo sehemu kubwa ya kufikiri kwa uwazi.
s08.reading.lesson.05.steps.7.narration: Sikiliza maoni moja yanayosemwa kama ukweli redioni leo.
s08.reading.lesson.05.title: Ukweli au maoni
s08.reading.lesson.06.recap.0.prompt: Aya inaeleza mdudu anachokula na jinsi anavyosaidia mimea. Wazo kuu ni…
s08.reading.lesson.06.steps.0.narration: Aya kuhusu nyuki inaeleza wanachokula na jinsi wanavyosaidia maua. Wazo kuu ni nyuki. Liguse.
s08.reading.lesson.06.steps.1.feedback: Wazo kuu pamoja na maelezo. Vizuri.
s08.reading.lesson.06.steps.1.narration: Maelezo hueleza zaidi kuhusu wazo kuu.
s08.reading.lesson.06.steps.2.feedback: Ukiondoa maelezo aya inaendelea. Ondoa wazo kuu na inaanguka.
s08.reading.lesson.06.steps.2.narration: Wazo kuu ni kile aya nzima inahusu. Maelezo huthibitisha.
s08.reading.lesson.06.steps.3.feedback: Kile nyuki hufanya. Kila sentensi ni mfano wake.
s08.reading.lesson.06.steps.3.narration: Aya inasema nyuki hutengeneza asali, huchavusha maua na huishi mizingani. Gusa wazo kuu.
s08.reading.lesson.06.steps.4.feedback: Yoyote kati ya matatu. Maelezo ni ushahidi, si hoja.
s08.reading.lesson.06.steps.4.narration: Aya ile ile. Gusa maelezo moja ya kuunga mkono.
s08.reading.lesson.06.steps.5.feedback: Asali ni maelezo moja. Wazo kuu lazima lifunike yote.
s08.reading.lesson.06.steps.5.narration: Mtu alisema wazo kuu ni 'asali'. Gusa kwa nini ni dogo mno.
s08.reading.lesson.06.steps.6.feedback: La kwanza ni wazo kuu; mengine mawili ni sababu ni kweli.
s08.reading.lesson.06.steps.6.narration: Buruta haya chini ya kichwa sahihi: 'Volkeno ni hatari' / 'lava huunguza' / 'majivu huzuia jua'.
s08.reading.lesson.06.steps.7.narration: Soma aya moja leo usiku na useme wazo lake kuu kwa maneno sita au chini.
s08.reading.lesson.06.title: Wazo kuu na maelezo

s08.reading.story.01.pages.0.narration: Sam alifanya mazoezi wiki nzima kwa mbio kubwa. Alikuwa na wasiwasi lakini tayari.
s08.reading.story.01.pages.1.narration: Mwanzoni, alijikwaa! Lakini aliinuka na kuendelea kukimbia.
s08.reading.story.01.pages.2.narration: Goti lake liliuma na wengine walikuwa mbali mbele.
s08.reading.story.01.pages.3.narration: Alifikiria kuacha. Kisha akafikiria wiki ya mazoezi.
s08.reading.story.01.pages.4.narration: Alikimbia sehemu ya mwisho polepole kuliko alivyowahi, na hakuacha.
s08.reading.story.01.pages.5.narration: Hakushinda, lakini alimaliza, na akajisikia fahari. Kujitahidi ndiko muhimu zaidi!
s08.reading.story.01.parentNote: Uliza mhusika ni nani na imewekwa wapi.

s08.reading.story.02.pages.0.narration: Lena alikutana na neno asilolijua: 'Daraja la zamani lilikuwa hatarishi.'
s08.reading.story.02.pages.1.narration: Karibu asimame kuuliza. Badala yake akasoma sentensi inayofuata.
s08.reading.story.02.pages.2.narration: 'Hakuna aliyelivuka baada ya giza, na mbao mbili zilikosekana.'
s08.reading.story.02.pages.3.narration: Mbao zilizokosekana. Hakuna anayevuka. Hatarishi lazima limaanishe si salama.
s08.reading.story.02.pages.4.narration: Aliangalia kamusi baadaye. Si salama, na huenda likaanguka.
s08.reading.story.02.pages.5.narration: Alikuwa sahihi. Sentensi ilikuwa imemwambia muda wote.

s08.reading.story.02.title: Neno Alilokisia
s08.science.lesson.01.recap.0.prompt: Mnyororo wa chakula unapata nishati yake kwanza kutoka wapi?
s08.science.lesson.01.steps.0.narration: Anza mnyororo: jua hutoa nishati kwa ___?
s08.science.lesson.01.steps.1.feedback: Mbweha. Nishati hupita kwenye mnyororo wa chakula.
s08.science.lesson.01.steps.2.feedback: Mimea huinasa; kila kingine lazima kile ili kupata.
s08.science.lesson.01.steps.2.narration: Kila mnyororo wa chakula huanza juani. Hakuna kingine kinachojitengenezea nishati.
s08.science.lesson.01.steps.3.feedback: Kila mshale unamaanisha 'huliwa na'. Nishati husafiri upande mmoja tu.
s08.science.lesson.01.steps.3.narration: Jenga mnyororo: jua, nyasi, sungura, mbweha. Buruta kwa mpangilio.
s08.science.lesson.01.steps.4.feedback: Mbweha hamlishi sungura. Mishale ingeelekea nyuma.
s08.science.lesson.01.steps.4.narration: Mtu aliweka mbweha kabla ya sungura. Gusa kinachokosea.
s08.science.lesson.01.steps.5.feedback: Wanapata njaa. Ondoa kiungo kimoja na kila kilicho juu yake huathirika.
s08.science.lesson.01.steps.5.narration: Sungura wote wakitoweka, gusa kinachotokea kwa mbweha.
s08.science.lesson.01.steps.6.feedback: Umbo lile lile, wanyama tofauti. Kila mnyororo hufanya kazi hivi.
s08.science.lesson.01.steps.6.narration: Jenga mnyororo wa baharini: jua, mwani, samaki mdogo, sili.
s08.science.lesson.01.steps.7.narration: Fuatilia chakula chako cha jioni hadi juani leo.
s08.science.lesson.01.title: Minyororo ya chakula
s08.science.lesson.02.steps.0.narration: Samaki anaishi majini. Mvute samaki kwenye bwawa.
s08.science.lesson.02.steps.2.feedback: Ondoa kimoja kati ya vinne na mnyama hawezi kubaki.
s08.science.lesson.02.steps.2.narration: Makazi si mahali tu. Ni chakula, maji, hifadhi na hali ya hewa sahihi.
s08.science.lesson.02.steps.3.feedback: Barafuni. Mwili wake umeundwa kwa baridi, si kuzoea tu.
s08.science.lesson.02.steps.3.narration: Buruta dubu wa polar mahali manyoya yake mazito yanafaa.
s08.science.lesson.02.steps.4.feedback: Jangwani. Huhifadhi maji na miguu yake hutanda mchangani.
s08.science.lesson.02.steps.4.narration: Sasa ngamia. Mburute hadi makazi yanayomfaa.
s08.science.lesson.02.steps.5.feedback: Angepata joto kupita kiasi. Manyoya yanayomwokoa mahali pamoja humuua pengine.
s08.science.lesson.02.steps.5.narration: Gusa kinachotokea ukimhamisha dubu wa polar jangwani.
s08.science.lesson.02.steps.6.feedback: Marafiki. Wanyama wengi huishi peke yao maisha yao yote.
s08.science.lesson.02.steps.6.narration: Gusa kitu kimoja ambacho makazi hayalazimu kutoa: chakula, hifadhi, marafiki, maji.
s08.science.lesson.02.steps.7.feedback: Bustani, mtaa, paa — yote ni makazi.
s08.science.lesson.02.steps.7.narration: Taja makazi yaliyo nje ya mlango wako, na mnyama mmoja anayeyafaa.
s08.science.lesson.02.title: Makazi
s08.science.lesson.03.recap.0.prompt: Mimea hutengeneza chakula chake kutoka nini?
s08.science.lesson.03.recap.1.prompt: Jua, nyasi, sungura, mbweha ni mfano wa…
s08.science.lesson.03.steps.0.feedback: Mimea hutengeneza chakula kutoka mwanga wa jua.
s08.science.lesson.03.steps.1.feedback: 'Jua → nyasi → sungura → mbweha. Mnyororo wa chakula.'
s08.science.lesson.03.steps.1.narration: Sungura hula nyasi; mbweha humla sungura. Gusa kufuata mnyororo.
s08.science.lesson.03.steps.2.feedback: Ndiyo maana minyororo ni mifupi, na kwa nini mbweha huwa wachache kuliko sungura.
s08.science.lesson.03.steps.2.narration: Nishati hupungua kila hatua. Nyingi hupotea kama joto na msogeo.
s08.science.lesson.03.steps.3.feedback: Nyasi, kwa mbali. Kila ngazi inahitaji ngazi kubwa zaidi chini yake.
s08.science.lesson.03.steps.3.narration: Gusa kilicho kingi shambani: mimea ya nyasi au sungura.
s08.science.lesson.03.steps.4.feedback: Mbweha. Lazima apate sungura wa kutosha, nao wametawanyika.
s08.science.lesson.03.steps.4.narration: Gusa mnyama anayehitaji eneo kubwa zaidi kuishi: sungura au mbweha.
s08.science.lesson.03.steps.5.feedback: Piramidi, si mnara. Kila tabaka ni dogo kuliko lililo chini yake.
s08.science.lesson.03.steps.5.narration: Panga shamba kuwa piramidi: nyasi chini, kisha sungura, kisha mbweha.
s08.science.lesson.03.steps.6.feedback: Hukua nene na pori. Minyororo hufanya kazi chini na juu.
s08.science.lesson.03.steps.6.narration: Gusa kinachotokea kwa nyasi ikiwa sungura wote wataondoka.
s08.science.lesson.03.steps.7.feedback: Viungo vitatu ni mnyororo halisi. Huhitaji msitu.
s08.science.lesson.03.steps.7.narration: Tafuta mnyororo wa chakula mtaani mwako: mmea, mdudu, ndege.
s08.science.lesson.03.title: Minyororo ya chakula
s08.science.lesson.04.recap.0.prompt: Jiwe hushika umbo lake, kwa hivyo ni…
s08.science.lesson.04.recap.1.prompt: Juisi hutiririka na kujaza kikombe, kwa hivyo ni…
s08.science.lesson.04.steps.0.narration: Jiwe ni kigumu. Hubaki na umbo lake. Gusa kigumu.
s08.science.lesson.04.steps.1.narration: Juisi ni kiowevu; hewa ni gesi. Gusa kila moja.
s08.science.lesson.04.steps.2.feedback: Maji yale yale, hali tatu. Joto hulegeza; baridi hukaza tena.
s08.science.lesson.04.steps.2.narration: Jiwe, maji, hewa: kigumu, kiowevu na gesi hutofautiana kwa jinsi vipande vidogo vinavyoshikamana.
s08.science.lesson.04.steps.3.feedback: Vigumu viwili, kiowevu kimoja, gesi mbili. Umbo ndilo dokezo.
s08.science.lesson.04.steps.3.narration: Panga hivi: jiwe, maziwa, mvuke, kijiko, hewa.
s08.science.lesson.04.steps.4.feedback: Kiowevu. Kigumu huhifadhi umbo lake; gesi hujaza nafasi yote.
s08.science.lesson.04.steps.4.narration: Gusa hali inayochukua umbo la chombo chochote unachomwaga ndani.
s08.science.lesson.04.steps.5.feedback: Kitu kile kile, hali tofauti. Kuyeyuka hubadilisha hali, si kitu chenyewe.
s08.science.lesson.04.steps.5.narration: Mtu alisema barafu na maji ni vitu tofauti. Gusa kwa nini ni kosa.
s08.science.lesson.04.steps.6.feedback: Joto, mara mbili. Kigumu hadi kiowevu, kisha kiowevu hadi gesi.
s08.science.lesson.04.steps.6.narration: Gusa unachoongeza kugeuza barafu kuwa mvuke.
s08.science.lesson.04.steps.7.feedback: Vyote ni mzunguko wa maji unaotokea jikoni kwako.
s08.science.lesson.04.steps.7.narration: Tazama birika au glasi baridi leo na taja mabadiliko ya hali kwa sauti.
s08.science.lesson.04.title: Hali za mata
s08.science.lesson.05.parentNote: Tazama kidimbwi kikipungua siku ya jua — huo ni uvukizi.
s08.science.lesson.05.recap.0.prompt: Jua huyapasha maji na yakapanda hewani. Hiyo ni…
s08.science.lesson.05.recap.1.prompt: Mvuke wa maji hupoa na kuwa mawingu. Hiyo ni…
s08.science.lesson.05.steps.0.narration: Jua hupasha maji joto. YanaVUKIZA hewani. Gusa kuvukiza.
s08.science.lesson.05.steps.1.narration: Yanapoa kuwa mawingu (Kuganda), kisha yananyesha kama mvua (Kunyesha).
s08.science.lesson.05.steps.2.feedback: Maji yaliyo kwenye glasi yako yamezunguka mara nyingi kuliko mtu awezavyo kuhesabu.
s08.science.lesson.05.steps.2.narration: Mzunguko wa maji hauna mwanzo wala mwisho. Ndiyo maana ni mzunguko.
s08.science.lesson.05.steps.3.feedback: Kuyeyuka, kugandana, kunyesha, kukusanyika — kisha tena.
s08.science.lesson.05.steps.3.narration: Panga hatua nne kwa mpangilio: kugandana, kuyeyuka, kukusanyika, kunyesha.
s08.science.lesson.05.steps.4.feedback: Jua. Bila hilo maji yasingepanda kamwe.
s08.science.lesson.05.steps.4.narration: Gusa kinachoinua maji na kuendesha mzunguko mzima.
s08.science.lesson.05.steps.5.feedback: Maji yaliyopoa na kuwa matone madogo. Si mvuke, wala si moshi.
s08.science.lesson.05.steps.6.feedback: Ni maji yale yale yanayozunguka. Hakuna kipya kinachotengenezwa, ni kuhamishwa tu.
s08.science.lesson.05.steps.6.narration: Mtu alisema mvua ni maji mapya. Gusa kwa nini haiwezi kuwa kweli.
s08.science.lesson.05.steps.7.feedback: Kuyeyuka na kugandana, mita kumi kutoka unapolala.
s08.science.lesson.05.steps.7.narration: Tafuta mzunguko katika siku moja: dimbwi limekwisha mchana, dirisha baridi usiku.
s08.science.lesson.05.title: Mzunguko wa maji
s08.science.lesson.06.recap.0.prompt: Sumaku hufanya nini kwa baadhi ya madini?
s08.science.lesson.06.steps.0.narration: Sumaku huVUTA baadhi ya metali. Gusa kuvuta kibanio.
s08.science.lesson.06.steps.1.narration: Ncha mbili zinazofanana huSUKUMANA. Gusa kuhisi msukumo.
s08.science.lesson.06.steps.2.feedback: Alumini ni madini na sumaku haiijali kabisa.
s08.science.lesson.06.steps.2.narration: Sumaku huvuta chuma — si kila madini, wala si plastiki au mbao.
s08.science.lesson.06.steps.3.feedback: Klipu ya karatasi. Ni chuma, na chuma kina madini ya chuma.
s08.science.lesson.06.steps.3.narration: Gusa kile sumaku itachukua: klipu ya karatasi, sarafu, mpira wa raba.
s08.science.lesson.06.steps.4.feedback: Zinasukumana. Ncha zinazofanana husukumana; zinazopingana huvutana.
s08.science.lesson.06.steps.4.narration: Ncha mbili za kaskazini zinaletwa pamoja. Gusa wanachofanya.
s08.science.lesson.06.steps.5.feedback: Inafanya. Usumaku hupita kwenye vitu visivyo vya sumaku.
s08.science.lesson.06.steps.5.narration: Gusa kama sumaku bado inafanya kazi kupitia karatasi.
s08.science.lesson.06.steps.6.feedback: Alumini, au shaba. Madini mengi si ya sumaku hata kidogo.
s08.science.lesson.06.steps.6.narration: Mtu alisema sumaku huvuta madini yote. Gusa madini yanayothibitisha ni kosa.
s08.science.lesson.06.steps.7.feedback: Kutabiri kabla ya kujaribu ndiyo sayansi yote.
s08.science.lesson.06.steps.7.narration: Jaribu vitu vitano nyumbani kwa sumaku ya friji na utabiri kila kimoja kwanza.
s08.science.lesson.06.title: Sumaku

s08.science.quiz.01.questions.3.retryFee: Jaribu kwenye kopo la kinywaji na klipu ya karatasi.

s08.science.quiz.02.questions.2.retryFee: Jangwa lina maji — kidogo sana tu.

s08.science.quiz.03.questions.0.prompt: Nini kiko mwanzoni mwa minyororo mingi ya chakula?
s08.science.quiz.03.questions.1.correctF: Nishati husafiri kufuata mshale, kutoka anayeliwa hadi anayekula.
s08.science.quiz.03.questions.1.prompt: Katika mnyororo nyasi → sungura → mbweha, mshale unamaanisha nini?
s08.science.quiz.03.questions.2.correctF: Ondoa kiungo kimoja na kila kilicho juu yake huathirika.
s08.science.quiz.03.questions.2.prompt: Sungura wote wakitoweka, nini kingetokea kwa mbweha?
s08.science.quiz.03.questions.2.retryFee: Mbweha hawawezi kusaga nyasi. Kagua kila mnyama anakula nini.
s08.science.quiz.03.questions.3.correctF: Kila ngazi inahitaji ngazi kubwa zaidi chini yake ya kula.

s08.science.quiz.03.questions.3.prompt: Kwa nini mbweha huwa wachache kuliko sungura daima?
s08.science.quiz.03.questions.3.retryFee: Fikiria mbweha mmoja anahitaji kula sungura wangapi.

s08.science.quiz.04.questions.0.correctF: Mimea tu ndiyo inayoweza kunasa nishati yake. Kingine lazima kile.
s08.science.quiz.04.questions.0.prompt: Nini kiko mwanzoni mwa karibu kila mnyororo wa chakula?
s08.science.quiz.04.questions.0.retryFee: Fanya kinyume hadi hakuna kinachokula kingine.
s08.science.quiz.04.questions.1.correctF: Kupasha joto na kupoza hubadilisha hali, si kitu chenyewe.

s08.science.quiz.04.questions.1.retryFee: Yeyusha barafu na uipime. Hakuna kilichopotea.
s08.science.quiz.04.questions.2.correctF: Kugandana. Maji yalipanda kama mvuke na kupoa.
s08.science.quiz.04.questions.2.retryFee: Angalia dirisha baridi siku ya joto.

s08.science.story.01.pages.1.narration: Ndio pekee hapa wanaoweza kujitengenezea chakula.
s08.science.story.01.pages.2.narration: Kiluwiluwi hutafuna mimea. Korongo huangalia karibu.
s08.science.story.01.pages.3.narration: Kuna maelfu ya mimea, mamia ya viluwiluwi, na korongo mmoja.
s08.science.story.01.pages.4.narration: Hilo si bahati. Kila ngazi hulisha ngazi ndogo zaidi juu yake.
s08.science.story.01.pages.5.narration: Kila kiumbe kina fungu lake. Bwawa liko hai!
s08.science.story.01.parentNote: Uliza nini kingetokea kiumbe kimoja kikitoweka.
s08.science.story.01.title: Siku Bwawani
s08.science.story.02.pages.0.narration: Baada ya mvua kulikuwa na dimbwi la ukubwa wa mlango.
s08.science.story.02.pages.1.narration: Kufikia adhuhuri lilikuwa limepungua hadi ukubwa wa sahani.
s08.science.story.02.pages.2.narration: Hakuna aliyeinywa. Jua lilikuwa limeinua hewani, tone moja kwa wakati.
s08.science.story.02.pages.3.narration: Juu ilipoa na kukusanyika na maji mengine kuwa wingu.
s08.science.story.02.pages.4.narration: Usiku ule wingu likawa zito na mvua ikanyesha tena.
s08.science.story.02.pages.5.narration: Asubuhi dimbwi lilikuwa limerudi. Maji yale yale, yakizunguka.
s08.science.story.02.parentNote: Chagua dimbwi halisi na uliangalie mara tatu kesho.

s08.social.lesson.01.recap.1.prompt: Wamisri waliandika kwa alama za picha zinazoitwa…
s08.social.lesson.01.steps.0.narration: Gusa piramidi kujifunza ilikuwa ya nini.
s08.social.lesson.01.steps.2.feedback: Cleopatra alipoishi, piramidi zilikuwa tayari historia ya kale.
s08.social.lesson.01.steps.2.narration: Misri ya Kale ilidumu miaka elfu tatu — zaidi ya muda tangu wakati huo.
s08.social.lesson.01.steps.3.feedback: Makaburi. Makaburi makubwa ya mawe kwa mafarao na mali zao.
s08.social.lesson.01.steps.3.narration: Gusa piramidi zilijengwa kuwa nini hasa.
s08.social.lesson.01.steps.4.feedback: Ilifurika kila mwaka na kuacha udongo wenye rutuba. Bila Nile, hakuna kilimo, hakuna Misri.
s08.social.lesson.01.steps.4.narration: Gusa kwa nini Nile ilikuwa muhimu kuliko kitu kingine chochote Misri.
s08.social.lesson.01.steps.5.feedback: Picha ziliwakilisha sauti na maneno, si michoro ya vitu tu.
s08.social.lesson.01.steps.5.narration: Hieroglifu zilikuwa mfumo halisi wa kuandika. Gusa maana yake.
s08.social.lesson.01.steps.6.feedback: Miaka elfu mbili na nusu ipo kati ya mawili ya kwanza.
s08.social.lesson.01.steps.6.narration: Panga haya kwa mpangilio, kongwe kwanza: piramidi zajengwa, Cleopatra atawala, leo.
s08.social.lesson.01.steps.7.feedback: Umefanya kile kila mfumo wa kuandika ulianza nacho.
s08.social.lesson.01.steps.7.narration: Andika herufi za jina lako kwa alama za picha unazobuni mwenyewe.
s08.social.lesson.01.title: Misri ya Kale
s08.social.lesson.02.recap.0.prompt: Kwenye ramani, ni upande upi ulio juu?
s08.social.lesson.02.recap.1.prompt: Kwenye ramani, ni upande upi ulio kulia?
s08.social.lesson.02.steps.0.narration: Kwenye ramani, kaskazini iko juu. Gusa kaskazini.
s08.social.lesson.02.steps.1.narration: Gusa mashariki (kulia), kisha kusini, kisha magharibi.
s08.social.lesson.02.steps.2.feedback: Jifunze mpangilio mara moja na utaweza kupata zile tatu nyingine daima.
s08.social.lesson.02.steps.2.narration: Kaskazini, Mashariki, Kusini, Magharibi huzunguka kwa mwendo wa saa, kwa mpangilio huo.
s08.social.lesson.02.steps.3.feedback: Kusini. Vinyume huwa upande wa pili wa duara daima.
s08.social.lesson.02.steps.3.narration: Unaelekea kaskazini. Gusa mwelekeo ulio nyuma yako.
s08.social.lesson.02.steps.4.feedback: Mashariki. Na magharibi iko kushoto. Kugeuka hubadilisha yote.
s08.social.lesson.02.steps.4.narration: Unaelekea kaskazini. Gusa kilicho mkono wako wa kulia.
s08.social.lesson.02.steps.5.feedback: Mashariki, daima. Ndivyo mabaharia walivyopata njia kwa maelfu ya miaka.
s08.social.lesson.02.steps.5.narration: Gusa mwelekeo jua linachomoza, popote duniani.
s08.social.lesson.02.steps.6.feedback: Kaskazini ni juu kwenye ramani, si ardhini. Ramani ni michoro, si vilima.
s08.social.lesson.02.steps.6.narration: Mtu alisema kaskazini daima ni kupanda. Gusa kwa nini ni kosa.
s08.social.lesson.02.steps.7.feedback: Jua la asubuhi juu yake maana yake unaelekea mashariki.
s08.social.lesson.02.steps.7.narration: Tambua mlango wako wa mbele unaelekea wapi, ukitumia jua.
s08.social.lesson.02.title: Pande za dira
s08.social.lesson.03.parentNote: Zungumzeni kuhusu kiongozi wa eneo na anachofanya.
s08.social.lesson.03.recap.1.prompt: Nani hufanya maamuzi kwa jamii nzima?
s08.social.lesson.03.steps.0.narration: Mji una kiongozi aitwaye meya. Gusa meya.
s08.social.lesson.03.steps.1.narration: Viongozi hufanya maamuzi kwa jamii nzima.
s08.social.lesson.03.steps.2.feedback: Barabara, maji na shule ni makubwa mno kwa familia moja kupanga.
s08.social.lesson.03.steps.2.narration: Jamii huchagua viongozi ili maamuzi yafanywe kwa wote kwa pamoja.
s08.social.lesson.03.steps.3.feedback: Baraza na meya — waliochaguliwa na wanaoishi hapo.
s08.social.lesson.03.steps.3.narration: Gusa nani huamua fedha za mji zinatumikaje.
s08.social.lesson.03.steps.4.feedback: Kiongozi anaweza kuondolewa kwa kura. Hiyo ndiyo tofauti nzima.
s08.social.lesson.03.steps.5.feedback: Muda wa kulala ni wako. Bustani na mabasi ni ya kila mtu.
s08.social.lesson.03.steps.5.narration: Panga haya: 'mji mzima huamua' na 'familia moja huamua': bustani mpya, muda wa kulala, njia ya basi.
s08.social.lesson.03.steps.6.feedback: Kuzungumza mkutanoni, kuwaandikia, na kupiga kura tofauti wakati ujao.
s08.social.lesson.03.steps.6.narration: Gusa watu wanachoweza kufanya wakiona kiongozi ameamua vibaya.
s08.social.lesson.03.steps.7.feedback: Kwa kawaida ni rahisi kujua kuliko watu wanavyotarajia.
s08.social.lesson.03.steps.7.narration: Tafuta nani anaongoza mji au wilaya yako, na jambo moja walilokata.
s08.social.lesson.03.title: Jamii na serikali
s08.social.lesson.04.recap.0.prompt: Ni umbo lipi la ardhi lililo refu na lenye miamba?
s08.social.lesson.04.recap.1.prompt: Ni kipi kati ya hivi ni ardhi iliyozungukwa na maji?
s08.social.lesson.04.steps.0.narration: Mlima ni mrefu na wenye miamba. Gusa mlima.
s08.social.lesson.04.steps.1.feedback: 'Mto na kisiwa. Dunia ina maumbo mengi ya ardhi.'
s08.social.lesson.04.steps.2.feedback: Karibu kila moja lilitengenezwa na kitu kinachosogea polepole sana.
s08.social.lesson.04.steps.2.narration: Maumbo ya ardhi ni maumbo maji na wakati vimechonga ardhini.
s08.social.lesson.04.steps.3.feedback: Kisiwa. Rasi ni karibu, lakini hubaki imeunganishwa upande mmoja.
s08.social.lesson.04.steps.3.narration: Gusa umbo la ardhi lenye maji pande zote.
s08.social.lesson.04.steps.4.feedback: Mto. Mto ndiyo kwa kawaida ulichonga bonde hapo mwanzo.
s08.social.lesson.04.steps.4.narration: Gusa kinachopita chini ya bonde kwa kawaida.
s08.social.lesson.04.steps.5.feedback: Mlima, kilima, tambarare, bonde. Urefu ndio hutaja mengi yao.
s08.social.lesson.04.steps.5.narration: Panga kwa urefu: mlima, kilima, tambarare, bonde.
s08.social.lesson.04.steps.6.feedback: Maji ya kunywa, udongo wa kulima, na njia inayosafirisha mashua bure.
s08.social.lesson.04.steps.6.narration: Gusa kwa nini miji mikubwa mingi ilikua kando ya mito.
s08.social.lesson.04.steps.7.feedback: Hata maeneo tambarare yana umbo ukiliangalia.
s08.social.lesson.04.steps.7.narration: Taja kilima cha juu zaidi na bonde la chini zaidi unaloweza kuona dirishani.
s08.social.lesson.04.title: Maumbo ya ardhi
s08.social.lesson.05.steps.0.narration: Mwokaji huZALISHA mkate. Mvute mwokaji kwa 'mzalishaji'.
s08.social.lesson.05.steps.2.feedback: Mwokaji anayeuza mkate hununua unga kutoka kwa mtu mwingine.
s08.social.lesson.05.steps.2.narration: Wazalishaji hutengeneza. Watumiaji hutumia. Karibu kila mtu ni wote wawili, kila siku.
s08.social.lesson.05.steps.3.feedback: Wawili wanazalisha, mmoja anatumia. Kitenzi hukuambia.
s08.social.lesson.05.steps.3.narration: Panga hawa: mkulima analima mahindi, familia inakula, mshonaji anashona.
s08.social.lesson.05.steps.4.feedback: Mtumiaji. Mtu yule yule hubadilisha majukumu mara nyingi kwa siku.
s08.social.lesson.05.steps.4.narration: Gusa mshonaji anakuwa nini wakati ananunua uzi.
s08.social.lesson.05.steps.5.feedback: Kutengeneza bila mnunuzi ni upotevu; kununua bila mtengenezaji si kitu.
s08.social.lesson.05.steps.5.narration: Gusa kwa nini mji unahitaji wazalishaji na watumiaji.
s08.social.lesson.05.steps.6.feedback: Mkulima, msagaji, mwokaji. Kila mmoja ni mtumiaji wa aliyemtangulia.
s08.social.lesson.05.steps.6.narration: Fuatilia mkate nyuma: mwokaji, msagaji, mkulima. Wapange kwa mpangilio.
s08.social.lesson.05.steps.7.feedback: Kazi ya nyumbani inahesabika. Vivyo hivyo mchoro.
s08.social.lesson.05.steps.7.narration: Taja vitu vitatu ulivyotumia leo na kitu kimoja ulichozalisha.
s08.social.lesson.05.title: Wazalishaji na watumiaji
s08.social.lesson.06.parentNote: Shiriki jinsi familia yenu inavyosherehekea jambo maalum.
s08.social.lesson.06.steps.0.narration: Watu husherehekea kwa njia nyingi, kwa chakula, muziki, na ngoma. Gusa kuchunguza sherehe.
s08.social.lesson.06.steps.1.feedback: Dunia yetu ina utajiri wa tamaduni.
s08.social.lesson.06.steps.2.feedback: Mavuno, mwaka mpya na kuwakumbuka waliokufa hujitokeza karibu kila mahali.
s08.social.lesson.06.steps.2.narration: Mavuno, mwaka mpya, siku ya kuzaliwa: sherehe huadhimisha kile kikundi kinakubali kinastahili kusimama.
s08.social.lesson.06.steps.3.feedback: Chakula cha kutosha kudumu majira ya baridi. Hilo halikuwa hakika.
s08.social.lesson.06.steps.3.narration: Gusa sherehe nyingi za mavuno zinashukuru kwa nini hasa.
s08.social.lesson.06.steps.4.feedback: Kushirikiana chakula. Ndiyo njia ya zamani zaidi ya kusema tuko pamoja.
s08.social.lesson.06.steps.4.narration: Gusa kitu ambacho karibu kila sherehe duniani inajumuisha.
s08.social.lesson.06.steps.5.feedback: Uliza ni ya nini. Kila moja ina maana kwa mtu.
s08.social.lesson.06.steps.5.narration: Mtu alicheka muziki na chakula cha sherehe asiyoielewa. Gusa jibu bora zaidi.
s08.social.lesson.06.steps.6.feedback: Mwisho wa saumu, mwanga juu ya giza, na mwaka wa mtu mmoja.
s08.social.lesson.06.steps.6.narration: Linganisha kila moja na inachoadhimisha: Idi, Diwali, siku ya kuzaliwa.
s08.social.lesson.06.steps.7.narration: Muulize mtu kuhusu sherehe ambayo familia yako haiadhimishi.
s08.social.lesson.06.title: Sherehe
